chapters.title: Chapter 2311 Extremity Sanctification! VI
paragraphs: <Extremity Sanctification...>
Ophelia spoke out calmly as her eyes perused over the many new beings before her who were connected to the Sacrarium Master.

Her eyes even came to lock onto the young man who truly didn't deserve to be called Little Henry anymore, his figure looking valiant as if he was the young prince of an ancient haven visiting common lands!

Ophelia sensed the Boundary of Quintessence from this being along with the potent Bloodline of the Sacrarium Master, Wisdom shining in her eyes as they were led over to Adelaide and the few other dazzlingly beautiful women here as she smiled even brighter.

<Wisdom says it is an opportunity that only those who live through it will enjoy. Those who manage to survive it in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution will be elevated ever closer to Extremity as the lands that the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans stem from are filled with Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.>
<This is connected to the nature of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution itself and the Havens of Extremity as a whole, something that all of our Lineages have been trying to understand...>
As she spoke, she floated towards Queen Adelaide and clasped her hands, kissing her cheeks in a greeting before she bent down to do the same towards the much shorter Barbatos.

<...It deals with one of the core basis of Extremity itself, where Wisdom is interpreting it as a natural phenomenon to put pressure on the countless Lifeforms here, spurring those who can bear such a pressure to evolve into more complex Lifeforms...thus, the process of Extremity Sanctification!>
WAA!
Her utterly shocking beauty as she casually talked about unimaginably important things left many of the inhabitants of the Infinite Plane shaken!

Since she was a being at the 9th Boundary Layer and closer to Extremity than most others here, the beauty she displayed was something very few others matched here as only Adelaide with the Bloodline of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor had a similar glow.
Her beauty didn't have its pronounced effect on Noah as he thought about her words and thought about himself.
He closed his eyes and felt his surging Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul.
He felt his main body in the Infinite Plane as it began to open the Golden and Obsidian Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches.

He felt the process of his main body elevating previously eaten up Boundaries to the 3rd Boundary Layers with Complete Golden Aeonic Pearls of Extremity, only for him to burn and sacrifice these Boundaries repeatedly over and over again as he took everything from them and commanded it to flow into Loot, Quintessence, Blood, and Manadynamics!

He also saw the usage of a Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity that would take a Boundary to the 6th Boundary Layer...be utilized for the Boundary of Dimensions as he wanted to spur the growth of his Origin even faster!

He felt all of these things as his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul burned with the light of Refinement and Strengthening, his Will surging as Aeonic Soul Values were spent...the Aeonic Annals of Extremity opening before him once more.
He sought knowledge and information.

He sought to understand just what there would be in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution for him...and how he could best benefit from it! His soul was fixated on the creatures being released from the Abyss!

His will buzzed as out of the innumerable books he could view in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, he focused on his current timeline as information began to flow into his mind, his Aeonic Soul Values rapidly declining and his Aeonic Mana of Extremity surged to fill in the gaps.

He finally understood why even the Seers or Augurs who could view the Aeonic Annals of Extremity had little information on this as pulling it up took a great deal of power and effort- with Ophelia actually becoming one of the beings capable of peering into this Record after she reached the 9th Boundary Layer of Wisdom- even though she didn't have a Consummate Boundary!

<Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans>:: Unique lifeforms born in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands under the concentrated essence of Extremity rising from the Extremity Vein of Dissolution. Their bodies were constantly refined and reformed, only to be reborn with utter closeness to Extremity as their Origins were tainted with the Vessels of Extremity prevalent in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution- the states of verisimilitude RUIN and NULLITY. They carry extremely old blood within them as their nature leans heavily onto the lineages of Prions, Parvoviridae, and many other nanoscopic lifeforms. Their bodies are as destructive as they are filled with an overabundance of treasure for any beings capable of destroying their souls. Their purpose is singular in nature as they serve to spur the process of Extremity in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution...
WAA!
Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans!
Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
Extremity Vein of Dissolution!
Wondrous terms jumped into Noah's mind as his eyes became extremely sharp.

His Aeonic Soul Values and Aeonic Mana of Extremity continued to be drained as while boundless information surged towards him, his point of view refocused in the outer periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands that was simply referred to as the Abyss before.

His True Sanguine Clone that was here was surrounded by its three stellar Planar Domains, his eyes coming to lock onto the multiple Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans that were raging their might across the stellar black earth, and those that were rising from these Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands and taking to the dark skies as their purpose...was to actually spread into the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
Onto the lands where multiple Lineages were trying to establish their Hegemony!
He looked at all this...as everything around him slowed down.
He saw that the power which a single Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan gave off could rival Reverend Emperors who had reached the 9th Boundary Layer.
To even get past them, he had to get past the three Reverends that surrounded him and Ophelia.

Reverends that rebuffed his stanchions of Loot light from his Halcyon Plane of Loot and resisted his pull of Blood even with his overbearing sanguinity, and they pushed back the <Quintessential Empyrean Planar Guards> formed from the Planar Domain of Quintessence!

And seeing the gradually increasing disorder of the situation around them, the three Reverends bellowed out to quickly finish him off as they initiated something only those who had achieved the 9th Boundary Layer could do so.
HOONG!
Their Aspects of Existence scattered into their unfolding Planar Domains as these existences undertook a process known as....Aeonic Boundary Manifestation.
When one examplified their Boundary as they turned into it entirely!
It was a terrifying power for Noah to withstand as his Main Body worked with haste to sacrifice Boundary Layers as fuel for even greater strength!

sentences.text: <Extremity Sanctification...>
Ophelia spoke out calmly as her eyes perused over the many new beings before her who were connected to the Sacrarium Master.

Her eyes even came to lock onto the young man who truly didn't deserve to be called Little Henry anymore, his figure looking valiant as if he was the young prince of an ancient haven visiting common lands!

Ophelia sensed the Boundary of Quintessence from this being along with the potent Bloodline of the Sacrarium Master, Wisdom shining in her eyes as they were led over to Adelaide and the few other dazzlingly beautiful women here as she smiled even brighter.
<Wisdom says it is an opportunity that only those who live through it will enjoy.

Those who manage to survive it in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution will be elevated ever closer to Extremity as the lands that the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans stem from are filled with Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.>
<This is connected to the nature of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution itself and the Havens of Extremity as a whole, something that all of our Lineages have been trying to understand...>
As she spoke, she floated towards Queen Adelaide and clasped her hands, kissing her cheeks in a greeting before she bent down to do the same towards the much shorter Barbatos.

<...It deals with one of the core basis of Extremity itself, where Wisdom is interpreting it as a natural phenomenon to put pressure on the countless Lifeforms here, spurring those who can bear such a pressure to evolve into more complex Lifeforms...thus, the process of Extremity Sanctification!>
WAA!
Her utterly shocking beauty as she casually talked about unimaginably important things left many of the inhabitants of the Infinite Plane shaken!

Since she was a being at the 9th Boundary Layer and closer to Extremity than most others here, the beauty she displayed was something very few others matched here as only Adelaide with the Bloodline of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor had a similar glow.
Her beauty didn't have its pronounced effect on Noah as he thought about her words and thought about himself.
He closed his eyes and felt his surging Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul.
He felt his main body in the Infinite Plane as it began to open the Golden and Obsidian Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches.

He felt the process of his main body elevating previously eaten up Boundaries to the 3rd Boundary Layers with Complete Golden Aeonic Pearls of Extremity, only for him to burn and sacrifice these Boundaries repeatedly over and over again as he took everything from them and commanded it to flow into Loot, Quintessence, Blood, and Manadynamics!

He also saw the usage of a Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity that would take a Boundary to the 6th Boundary Layer...be utilized for the Boundary of Dimensions as he wanted to spur the growth of his Origin even faster!

He felt all of these things as his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul burned with the light of Refinement and Strengthening, his Will surging as Aeonic Soul Values were spent...the Aeonic Annals of Extremity opening before him once more.
He sought knowledge and information.
He sought to understand just what there would be in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution for him...and how he could best benefit from it!
His soul was fixated on the creatures being released from the Abyss!

His will buzzed as out of the innumerable books he could view in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, he focused on his current timeline as information began to flow into his mind, his Aeonic Soul Values rapidly declining and his Aeonic Mana of Extremity surged to fill in the gaps.

He finally understood why even the Seers or Augurs who could view the Aeonic Annals of Extremity had little information on this as pulling it up took a great deal of power and effort- with Ophelia actually becoming one of the beings capable of peering into this Record after she reached the 9th Boundary Layer of Wisdom- even though she didn't have a Consummate Boundary!
<Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans>:: Unique lifeforms born in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands under the concentrated essence of Extremity rising from the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.

Their bodies were constantly refined and reformed, only to be reborn with utter closeness to Extremity as their Origins were tainted with the Vessels of Extremity prevalent in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution- the states of verisimilitude RUIN and NULLITY.
They carry extremely old blood within them as their nature leans heavily onto the lineages of Prions, Parvoviridae, and many other nanoscopic lifeforms.
Their bodies are as destructive as they are filled with an overabundance of treasure for any beings capable of destroying their souls.
Their purpose is singular in nature as they serve to spur the process of Extremity in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution...
WAA!
Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans!
Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
Extremity Vein of Dissolution!
Wondrous terms jumped into Noah's mind as his eyes became extremely sharp.

His Aeonic Soul Values and Aeonic Mana of Extremity continued to be drained as while boundless information surged towards him, his point of view refocused in the outer periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands that was simply referred to as the Abyss before.

His True Sanguine Clone that was here was surrounded by its three stellar Planar Domains, his eyes coming to lock onto the multiple Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans that were raging their might across the stellar black earth, and those that were rising from these Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands and taking to the dark skies as their purpose...was to actually spread into the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
Onto the lands where multiple Lineages were trying to establish their Hegemony!

Reverends that rebuffed his stanchions of Loot light from his Halcyon Plane of Loot and resisted his pull of Blood even with his overbearing sanguinity, and they pushed back the <Quintessential Empyrean Planar Guards> formed from the Planar Domain of Quintessence!

When one examplified their Boundary as they turned into it entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 2312 Slay A Reverend! I
paragraphs: Aeonic Boundary Manifestation.

Even with all the chaos occurring in the outer periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, such a release of power was potent as it was one of the more powerful releases of power of the Reverend Emperors.

To Noah's left, the Reverend Emperor of the Noblesse Lineage bellowed out as his surrounding reality had entirely turned into an inky black VOID, his entire body turning into blackness as he became one with the VOID and manifested this Boundary entirely- a sea of liquid darkness barreling towards Noah as it devoured everything on its path!
Above Noah, the Quasarian Reverend had a cold expression as his body exploded into a massive Singularity.

A singularity that blazed with shocking temperature and gravity as at its depths, a crimson purple stellar eye opened as it released a volatile ray of extreme heat that even singed 8th Boundary Layer experts a distance away- with its target being Noah's billowing figure surrounded by auras, barriers, and a sea of cerulean flames of Infinity symbols!
And to add onto this, the Ancestral Lernaean Reverend Emperor released a furious grant at not getting any answers from Ophelia as the immense white gold light of the Sword erupted.

His visage disappeared and turned into a titanic white gold sword that surged with a sea of minuscule swords around it, with the sword tip of this Manifestation cutting everything on its path as it sought Noah's Aspects of Existence!
SHAA!
The most powerful attacks of all 3 Reverends flew out as the myriad of Defensive Layers began to be shredded.
Noah's body felt the coming power closely as around him, countless Realities bloomed as his Aeonic Mana of Extremity endlessly conjured skills!
But there was still a gap.
Those that had built a pathway towards the 9th Boundary Layers were still too powerful as he was only in the process of elevating his own Layers forward!
BZZT!

Time slowed as an endless inky darkness, a blazing ray of gravity and heat, and an endlessly sharp sword actually worked in conjunction to release hundreds of millions of Aeonic Soul Damage Values, a vast majority of it being slowed down and eaten up by the countless abilities spammed as at the end of it all...
It wasn't enough!
SAA!
The white gold sword arrived the fastest as it tore the Mana Barrier and sank into the glorious chest of the True Emperor of Quintessence.
The endless VOID arrived thereafter as it entirely covered the limbs of the True Emperor of Quintessence and seemed ready to melt them!
And the volatile ray released from a singularity that could very well eradicate average newly advanced Reverends...arrived right before his head.
A terrifying development.
Time seemed to be moving utterly slow as Noah's stellar eyes were opened wide in the face of all this.
The sharp sword sunk into his chest.
The VOID covering all his limbs.
And the volatile ray of singularity right before his face.
Just from this distance, his reforged and transformed skin should have begun to melt!
And yet...it didn't.
In this slowed time, his face actually formed a dazzling smile as his Will emanated out simple words that caused the Souls of the Aeonic Soul Sublimation Reverends to shudder.
<Got you.>

Their Wills showed alarm as the being their attacks had arrived and smashed into actually hadn't perished, with drastic changes occurring in the next moment as the fair light stellar skin of this being...peeled off to reveal a blue stellar layer.
A Layer of skin that seemed to be made of pure Mana from ancient times- his body erupting with this color all around as the VOID that covered his limbs...was tightly held onto.
It was the activation of the Planar Domain of Manadynamics.
It was the attainment of the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity that passively transformed any sources of essence that it came in contact with into its own essence.

At the cost of 10% of his Aeonic Soul Values every nanosecond, he could release a shocking domain and take on this form as with it active, he had the Complete Extremity Nullification I that ignored Damage from the 9th Boundary Layer of Extremity and below!
HOONG!
Alarm and shock were felt in the hearts of the three Reverends as amidst blooming dreadful cerulean lights, they pulled back.

The three beings felt unprecedented danger as the white gold sword and Quasarian light of singularity were able to pull a certain distance, but the endlessly dark taint of the VOID...felt clasped as something else had finally made a move at this moment.

With her entire body covered by a halcyon light of utter majesty as her radiant light brown skin couldn't even be seen, Ophelia made a move at this moment as her mind seemed one with the being Wisdom told her to rely on!
She was akin to a pure golden light of Wisdom as she transformed into a single Word of Wisdom!
A word that directed all of its power towards the inky black VOID as it stated a simple command.
[BIND]
HUUUM!

The terrifying power of the 9th Boundary Layer of Wisdom was released for the first time as the Reverend Emperor from the Noblesse Lineage wasn't able to pull back for even a moment, this immense darkness finding itself becoming surrounded by an unbelievable cerulean reality as the being it was devouring the body of focused on it with a devilish smile.

The body of the True Emperor of Quintessence had entirely changed as it expanded massively, the form of an Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity being taken gradually as at this moment, a shocking sense of power and grandeur that should in no way be possible was being released from him!
A power that was in no way his as this...lay in the core secret of the attainment of the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity and Manadynamics.

In this form, Noah had the Complete Extremity Nullification I as the most critical piece...was the fact that he could transform any sources of essence that he came in contact with into its own essence.
The core of Manadynamics!
Energy was neither created nor destroyed- only changed into different forms!
And he...took the attacks of three Reverend Emperors in this form!

chapters.title: Chapter 2313 Slay A Reverend! II
paragraphs: He took the attacks of three Reverend Emperors in the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity form!
The essence of the strongest attacks of three 9th Boundary Layer experts!
The hundreds of millions of billowing Aeonic Soul Damage Values were received and transformed.
They weren't lost.

Noah felt the billowing waves of essence surging in his new form with utter ease as he felt like the embodiment of Manadynamics, altering these raging hundreds of millions of Aeonic Soul Damage Values as he redirected them towards a single being!
The weakest Reverend out of the ones who had attacked him, and the one unlucky enough to not be able to pull back in time as he had the help of Ophelia to keep him in place.
It was someone powerful that at his current stage of Power, Noah undoubtedly could not take down.
He didn't have the damage values to do so, nor was his soul overpoweringly more powerful than it!
But he could scheme to much greater degrees as with the tools he had from his reality-breaking abilities...some shocking things were possible.

So he took the strongest attacks of three 9th Boundary Layer Reverends at this moment as without losing even an iota of their energies, he transformed it all into Aeonic Soul Damage Values that coursed with Manadynamics and Quintessence as it was all redirected onto the soul of a single being.
And herein came another fantastical wonder today.
When an Aeonic Soul Sublimation Reverends manifested with their domains and became one with their Boundary, their soul was spread out evenly around it.

And with all of the VOID clustered around Noah while the rest of it was bound by Ophelia momentarily, this Noblesse could only feel the sensation of an unprecedented danger increase to unimaginable levels as horrific levels of the power of three Reverend Emperors was centralized and released to ravage his soul!
<HOOOOO!!!>
A billowing cry of disbelief, unwillingness, shock, and pain boomed out and split the skies!
A flash of the VOID erupted to momentarily turn everything in the surroundings black!

And then...a burning blue light shone as if it was the rising of an unstoppable cerulean sun, baptizing everything in its grandiosity as it utterly tore apart the Manifestation of an Aeonic Soul Sublimation Reverend, a shocking level of Damage Values being released as even those nearby paled and turned over this direction in shock!
What they found...was a shining blue sun rising as around it, fractures of the VOID bathed with crimson gold blood stretched out.
It was the blood and soul of an existence with an extremely strong soul.
An existence with a sublimated soul!

The scene had shocking meaning to any who saw the progression of events and even those looking over now, their eyes unable to see the shining blue sun that was revealed to be a humanoid figure at this moment.
Above his head, a cluster of stellar blue crowns rotated with mad majesty.
Behind it, five pairs of auroras of cerulean wings that extended like endless seas could be seen.

Four limbs could be seen stretched out from its built humanoid form as if it was some ancient cerulean celestial creature of aged times, its whole body emanating a terrifying pressure as the face...carried exceeding beauty and handsomeness as only 2 eyes were present on this face- these two eyes seeming like a cluster of blue singularities!
It was the grandness of the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity.

A being that those seeing for the first time inscribed in their souls as the truth of reality from what they could see...was the torn VOID and soul of a Reverend that unbelievably showed one had actually fallen here!
WAA!
It was too shocking to be believed as even when the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans were released as they raged with their power, no 9th Boundary Reverend had fallen.
Yet...one just fell so simply to this new entrant they hadn't seen before?
Even in common times, a Reverend Emperor perishing was nearly an impossibility in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution unless under extremely terrifying circumstances.

For one to fall now...it caused an immense amount of attention to be clustered towards the being responsible for it as the two Reverend Emperors of the Ancestral Lernaeans and Quasarians who were attacking Noah just now...they actually did not advance anymore.
Their manifested forms shone with grandeur as they actually didn't continue their attacks when they looked at the Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity before them!

This was because they had felt the same unprecedented level of danger that caused the death of the Noblesse Reverend, but what they didn't know was that this feeling stemmed from the transformed energy of the attacks of the three Reverends put together.
They didn't know that this being before this simply used their own power and transformed it into another form of essence that he then released!
So they labeled him as a terrifying Entity that could withstand attacks from three Reverends and even release a single attack to kill a Reverend.
It was the beginning of a new Legend that was etched just as the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands opened and the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans were released!
One of the first beings to fall was actually a powerhouse of the Noblesse as the one responsible for it all.. gazed out with utter wonder and euphoria as prompts cascaded before him in waves.
<An Unprecedented Achievement!>
<You have extinguished the Aeonic Soul of an existence levels above you in power!>
<The Boundaries of Loot and Quintessence have strongly reacted as a truly Quintessential Cache is being born!>
Utmost multicolored brilliance shone around him as everything about the Noblesse Reverend Emperor was devoured.
And its result...
<1x Crimson Aeonic Quintessential Extremity Treasure Cache of Nilado has been obtained!>
A treasure cache that unlike all the previous Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches, it had the term Extremity within it.
It shone with utmost grandiosity in Noah's Expansive Space as it took up 50% of all the space, seeming to be as vast as a plane of existence as it opened right away!
As if it couldn't contain the wonders within it!
And even more unprecedented prompts fell before Noah.
<1x Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearl of Extremity has been obtained.>
<1x Complete Crimson I Aeonic Pearl of Extremity has been obtained.>
<8x Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity has been obtained.>
<10x Complete Golden Aeonic Pearl of Extremity has been obtained.>
<1,000x Refined Aeonic Sanguine Singularities have been obtained.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2314 Destiny Makes a Move!
paragraphs: An unbelievable reality!
Amongst the ranks of Noblesse, fury and disbelief rose as their Reverend Emperors gazed at the situation behind them and roared out with power.

But their Wills were still too focused on the terrifying Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans that continued to erupt out, as well as their advancement into the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands where dazzling rays of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity could be seen.
And even if they wanted to divide their attention to the far back where the Noblesse Reverend Emperor Nilado had fallen...
BOOOM!

The Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans truly did not allow it as among the ranks of Noblesse, one Leviathan with the name <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> ruptured across the skies to smash into the very center of their Legions.
It was a massive beast that looked like a massive titanic shark, wings of RUIN and NULLITY surging on its back as its fins swirled with volatile singularities!

Its red eyes roared out with maddening anger at this moment as it rushed to this location with purpose, entering the depths of the Legions of Noblesse for nothing else other than the massive Eyes that flashed their light towards it and its brethren!
The dugout eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform- the Eyes of Clarity!
ROAAR!

The gazes of the Noblesse in charge of guarding and utilizing the Eyes changed as one Reverend that was making her way into the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands changed direction to return- not thinking the Eyes of Clarity would be singularly targeted.
And just like that...the unbelievable actions that a certain True Emperor had taken could not be focused on or addressed as this region...was simply too chaotic.

There was an overabundance of disorder as even though the death of a Reverend Emperor that was sublimely had just occurred, most other beings had to continue making decisions and moves right after just to keep their lives!
They could not do much else amidst such chaos!
'But if you can freely steer destiny amidst the most chaotic situations...'

In the ranks of Noblesse where the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> had begun going wild with multiple 8th Boundary Layer Existences releasing the VOID to stop its advancement, the visage of none other than Oppenheimer could be seen as his eyes swirled with a golden light of Destiny.
He hadn't made any move forward or backward since chaos erupted, with his gaze currently locked onto the far away cerulean form of a being that had just eradicated a Reverend Emperor.

When looking at this being, Oppenheimer felt an inexplicable sensation as his eyes carried a pondering expression, where even though a deadly Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan was already nearby and was unleashing destruction to decimate everything...he wasn't worried!

The reality around him was even shocking for those who were truly listening as every now and then, amidst the chaos and Noblesse Commanders around him releasing waves of the VOID to attack, one could see Oppenheimer's figure make a few steps to the left and right ever so often.
And the area he was just at a few nanoseconds ago...would be ravaged with tendrils of NULLITY or RUIN as it seemed he was just a step ahead before it struck.
He veered across the battlefield simply as if he had no goal or direction as he shockingly avoided the waves of fight and chaos around him, but the reality was much different!
It was not that he didn't have a goal or that he didn't wish to seek opportunities like everyone else here to delve into the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
It was just that he knew his Destiny lay elsewhere.
And...a critical time was actually coming as he became exceedingly calm.
His gaze remained on the cerulean Emperor in the distance a bit longer as he nodded, affirming the faint connection with his soul as soon after, the golden light of Destiny around him flickered.
His reason for being here was about to unfold.
BOOOM!

Behind him, lightning bolts made of RUIN surged around like Apocalyptic thunder as it rained down on the Noblesse nearby, the 8th Boundary Layer experts not being able to hold on as their barriers were shattered, and chains holding the Eyes of Clarity tightly started to become undone!
<No!>
The Noblesse Commanders bellowed out with rising rage as they released their power even more, but the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> was too dreadful.
Its essence had already affected and tainted nearby Noblesse as their eyes changed, beginning to turn on their own brethren around them as even more chaos unfolded!
And at such a time, the aurora of wings above the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> fluttered while its jaws opened wide towards the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform.
Towards that something that would be akin to a tonic for it!
BZZZT!

A terrifying layer of protection that was ever present on these Eyes flashed at this moment as the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> was about to devour it, this barrier being something that could withstand attacks and interferences from even a 9th Boundary Layer existence as in a matter of a few nanoseconds...the Crimson jagged teeth of the Leviathan broke through it.
<No you don't!>
WAA!
into chains of the VOID that wrapped around the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> to stop its advancement!

And at such a time, the Noblesse Reverend Emperor that had turned around to come to this location arrived, her hands forming into chains of the VOID that wrapped around the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> to stop its advancement!
Yet this creature boasted too much power as its body instantly turned into a fluid form, seeming like endless Crimson silver foam that bypassed everything to devour what they sought.
<OOOH!>

And an inky darkness was released from the Noblesse Reverend Emperor as she actuated her Planar Domain and even went as far as to manifest the VOID to stop this terrifying beast, feeling it slip past her as he bellowed out.
<Do not let the Eyes be devoured!>
Her words spurred the shocked Noblesse nearby as they tried to near the tendrils of raging RUIN and NULLITY while also fighting against their tainted brethren.
And in such chaos...
WAA!
A golden light flashed as the True Emperor of Destiny made his move!

chapters.title: Chapter 2315 Destiny Makes a Move! II
paragraphs: Sifting between the tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN smoothly as destiny steered him, Oppenheimer successfully walked to appear in the middle of the two Eyes of Clarity that released a radiant light of power...a power than even passively kept the storm of NULLITY AND RUIN back as these were the parts from an Apex Aeonic Lifeform after all!
His heart resonated with his soul as a golden light began to cascade from him in shocking waves.
While others came to these lands for opportunity, his was always right here.
He waited for it.
He could not bypass its protective layers and chains of control that the Noblesse had inserted before.
But now...all of it was shredded apart as only a passive light of protection of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform remained!
And at such a juncture, he made his move.
SHIING!

Seas of golden waves of Destiny erupted and coursed up the broken chains that used to control the Eyes of Clarity, hundreds of such golden chains forming and anchoring themselves onto the back of the eyes as soon after...they began to pull.

A vibrant golden sea erupted around him as a unique Planar Domain formed, the golden chains anchored to the Eyes of Clarity releasing a halcyon wave that covered them as the pulling sensation became even more immense...and the golden light covering the eyes caused them to begin miniaturized as they were pulled back!
And the myriad of golden chains...snaked out like daggers on the other end as they became anchored and stabbed into the golden eyes of the True Emperor of Destiny.

Crimson gold blood erupted as immense pain coursed through him, but his expression didn't change as the light of Destiny only became more potent around him, the Eyes of Clarity covered by it being pulled with even greater speed as they became even smaller- their destination already determined as chains of golden light pulled them towards the bleeding eyes of Oppenheimer!

All of these actions...occurred in an extremely short period of time as to others, the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform began to shrink amidst raging tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY, a golden light erupting to cover them briefly.
And when the <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> saw this, it roared out with mad anger as its body exploded with utmost power.
And a sea of RUIN and NULLITY appeared in the skies as it crashed down cataclysmically to drown everything!
<NO!>
The Noblesse Reverend Emperor cried out as her body released profound dark brilliance, barely being able to see as the Eyes of Clarity shrunk and disappeared amidst the storm of RUIN and NULLITY.
And...
BOOOM!
Light flashed.
Destiny bloomed.

And pure wonder ensued as within the stellar back earth that was withstanding crashing waves of NULLITY and RUIN, a figure breathing heavily could be seen as his eyes still maintained utmost calmness.
His Aeonic Soul was fully drained as it seemed like nothing remained, but this being opened his eyes in the next moment as...
A celestial and magisterial brilliance erupted from them.
The eyes pulsed with wonder.
The eyes pulsed with power of an utterly complex life form as the being that had transplanted them onto himself...felt his Aeonic Soul cry out at this moment as it began to surge!
Across the battlefield.

Far from the center of the Noblesse Legion where a <Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus> was running rampant, Noah's visage slowly lost its Aeonic Arcane Mana Entity state as the highly draining 6th Boundary Layer of Manadynamics was deactivated, and his vibrant eyes were forced to gaze towards the far away distance where he barely saw the scene of two massive eyes shrinking as a flash of golden light bloomed!
A light he was all too familiar with as even amidst the chaos...his eyes provided clarity and they shone with a sharp light.
'Oppenheimer...'
He uttered the name of the anomalous being that had fractured the very fabric of Reality as in his mind, countless thoughts were computed within an instant!

A section of his Will was dedicated towards this issue as at this moment where he faced no deadly attacks from enemies for at least a few nanoseconds, another major section of his Will was focused on giving him yet another rebirth and transformation.
It would of course be a rebirth due to the boons that came from eliminating a 9th Boundary Layer Reverend Emperor!

He had to move fast in this short period of time as like before, he sought to expand an instant into a much longer period of time with his main body in the Infinite Plane as deep in the Source of Reality, the effects of the feature of Time Dilation could easily be expressed.
So he gazed at the most pristine Loot to come from the death of a being many levels higher than him!

<Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearl of Extremity>:: A type of Loot of Extremity that has a chance of coming out from defeated enemies that have at least reached the 9th Boundary Layer...This Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearl of Extremity contains within it references to expand any concept to the 9th Boundary Layer, with the expanded concept having a ranking of a Crimson Innate Boundary at the very least. Consuming more Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity on the same Boundary will have a unique influence of enhancing the quality of the selected Boundary, edging it ever close to the Consummate Boundary Tier before it even reaches the 10th Boundary Layer....
A Loot with utterly shocking capabilities that should not exist.

A Loot that propelled a concept all the way to the 9th Boundary Layer- something that even the vast majority of the first generation of Ancestral Lernaeans who had arrived into the Havens of Extremity billions of years ago had yet to achieve!
Yet Noah unimaginably made it possible through his ridiculous concepts.
And at this moment, he made a choice on what the usage of such a ridiculous Loot would be without any hesitation.
HOONG!
The Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearl of Extremity shone with a blinding light of a singularity as Noah devoured it all instantly.
And deep within his soul...
<Rise...Quintessence.>
The concept that defined him was roused.
The concept that just with its advancement...it would propel the advancement of all others forward!

chapters.title: Chapter 2316 Reverend! I
paragraphs: A great number of things were happening all at once as Noah had to prioritize multiple different things with his strong soul and bodies.
He tuned out any background noise to focus on the glorious task at hand as just the beginning of the entrance into the Havens of Extremity, a day was barely considered to have passed.
·ƈθm A day.
And yet towards the end of this day, he was on the precipice of reaching a stage of power that took others billions of years!
The paths that different beings took were countless in nature as others may have slowly progressed across the Boundary Layers of Extremity and experienced them slowly over time.

But Noah was making incremental jumps within a matter of hours as the only way he could be like the masses...was to sit in his Infinite Plane and not be involved in anything. But even then, he would still grow at an exponentially faster pace than others!
But when he did wade across the river of Providence, even more miraculous things happened as at this moment...
<The Seventh Boundary Layer of Quintessence has been achieved.>
His main body floated in the Source of Reality while surrounded by waves of blazing multicolored radiance.

Quintessence surged around him as it continued to refine and strengthen his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul, its elevation not being isolated to it as the effects of this concept were simply too immense.
His eyes were closed as he felt the wondrous unfolding changes across his Aspects of Existence, with prompts continuing to fall amidst the surge of brilliance!
<The Eighth Boundary Layer of Quintessence has been achieved.>
Step by step, as if it were ever so damn easy for him...he crossed thresholds that held others back for billions of years!

Something unique was that when his highest Boundary Layer was just the 7th Boundary Layer of Manadynamics, he had gained the fundamental change of his Soul that was fully integrated with all parts of him.
A hallmark of a being that had reached the 9th Boundary Layer- a Reverend!
He reached this stage in the level of his Soul way before he even neared the 9th Boundary Layer on any concept as what would happen now when he was actually on his way there?!
HOONG!
In the depths of the Infinite Plane, Noah's figure released entirely too much multicolored light as the Source of Reality began to tremble.
Outside of this spacetime continuum, the Aeonic Haven Boundary Space also began to seethe as with Noah's elevation- the essence of Quintessence flowing across the Infinite Plane also began to surge.
The truly fantastical thing was that from the depths of the Infinite Plane in the Source of Reality, the potent aura of Extremity was rising as its inhabitant and master reached a critical step!
<The Ninth Boundary Layer of Quintessence has been achieved.>
WAA!
Plasmic waves of the essence of a 9th Boundary Layer concept of Extremity surged madly as his bodies were swept in it.
His Origin cried out in euphoria as at the same time, the Sources of Extremity anchored within it released blinding radiance as they also surged!
Noah had just achieved the Ninth Boundary Layer of Quintessence as even before he could adjust to and understand the changes...
<New effects of the elevated Boundary of Quintessence are being applied.>
<The Seventh Boundary Layer of Loot has been achieved.>
<The Seventh Boundary Layer of Blood has been achieved.>

An overabundance of change and information flowed in as Noah once more reeled himself in, his Will organizing all caches of information as he focused to understand just what wonders Quintessence brought forth from its new Layers!

<The Seventh Boundary Layer of Quintessence>:: A myriad of concepts make who you are, with the most important ones bound to your very soul. In conjunction with the nature of Manadynamics and Blood, all concepts that have their Sources bound to your Soul are spurred towards Extremity, with a passive Automatic Quintessential Extremity reality-altering effect being applied to all your bound Sources as their initial start points will always be at the Third Boundary Layer of Extremity. Thereafter, their rate of progression towards Extremity will rapidly increase to reach your highest achieved Boundary Layer. The effect of this Layer will be altered and vary when other beings reach it...
'What even...'
A description of a Boundary Layer that made Noah's soul momentarily question reality rose as at this moment, it was truly actions that spoke louder than words!

The Seventh Boundary Layer of Quintessence spoke of applying an Automatic Quintessential Extremity reality altering effect to all of his bound Sources as their initial start points would always be at the Third Boundary Layer of Extremity!
It meant...
<All Bound Natural Laws, Decreta, and Fundamental Natural Laws, are being expanded towards the 3rd Boundary Layer.>
BOOM!
<The Decretum of Dreams has begun its expansion towards Extremity.>
<The Decretum of Avalon has begun its expansion towards Extremity.>
<The Decretum of Prana has begun its expansion towards Extremity.>
Gold, purple, and verdant waves of light erupted first as after them, even more varying colors followed as a change that even Noah himself didn't fully encapsulate the significance of began!

He had only just finished the process of binding all Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws in the past days as even greater changes were unfolding within him, their quantification being in process as he did not expect even grander changes to arrive before this.

This was even more so for the bound Decreta where they weren't even spurned towards Extremity by Manadynamics like it did for other Natural Laws, with Quintessence going above and beyond this as to put this change lightly...it was a passive and thorough explosion of power that meant within Noah's body, twice a dozen concepts were instantly being expanded towards Extremity as they would not stop until they reached the 3rd Boundary Layer!
The utterly profound changes to his Soul from such an action?
...were simply unimaginable as Noah couldn't help but bellow out as he sensed a false feeling of invincibility!
<OOOH!>

The effect of this Layer will be altered and vary when other beings reach it...
'What even...'
A description of a Boundary Layer that made Noah's soul momentarily question reality rose as at this moment, it was truly actions that spoke louder than words!

The Seventh Boundary Layer of Quintessence spoke of applying an Automatic Quintessential Extremity reality altering effect to all of his bound Sources as their initial start points would always be at the Third Boundary Layer of Extremity!
It meant...
<All Bound Natural Laws, Decreta, and Fundamental Natural Laws, are being expanded towards the 3rd Boundary Layer.>
BOOM!
<The Decretum of Dreams has begun its expansion towards Extremity.>
<The Decretum of Avalon has begun its expansion towards Extremity.>
<The Decretum of Prana has begun its expansion towards Extremity.>
Gold, purple, and verdant waves of light erupted first as after them, even more varying colors followed as a change that even Noah himself didn't fully encapsulate the significance of began!

He had only just finished the process of binding all Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws in the past days as even greater changes were unfolding within him, their quantification being in process as he did not expect even grander changes to arrive before this.

This was even more so for the bound Decreta where they weren't even spurned towards Extremity by Manadynamics like it did for other Natural Laws, with Quintessence going above and beyond this as to put this change lightly...it was a passive and thorough explosion of power that meant within Noah's body, twice a dozen concepts were instantly being expanded towards Extremity as they would not stop until they reached the 3rd Boundary Layer!
The utterly profound changes to his Soul from such an action?
...were simply unimaginable as Noah couldn't help but bellow out as he sensed a false feeling of invincibility!
<OOOH!>

chapters.title: Chapter 2317 Reverend! II
paragraphs: In the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, things only became increasingly more chaotic as Lernaeans, Quasarians, and Noblesse made some headway to surge into the deeper Lands beyond the veil at the risk of their very lives.
Some risked their Aeonic Soul Clones while others risked their main bodies, with a pull they could not ignore of the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity drawing them forward!

The Noblesse, on the other hand, suffered successive losses at this moment as after one of their Reverends inexplicably fell to an unknown combatant, and now the status of a treasure of great importance was unknown!

Towards the center of the Noblesse Legions, the Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus reformed multiple times over as it roared angrily, the Reverend Noblesse above it doing the same as when the scene cleared somewhat while the sea of RUIN and NULLITY faded, she and all other Noblesse couldn't see the Eyes of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform anymore!
<Find them! The Eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform cannot be destroyed so easily!>

The Noblesse Reverend roared out with power as she dove like an endless VOID towards the Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus, her expression utterly ugly as things were not flowing in a smooth direction so far.

But...below the fading sea of RUIN and NULLITY where others saw nothing, the visage of a handsome man lay on the caved in stellar black earth as his eyes released waves of multicolored light that covered his body.

Waves of light that couldn't be seen through even with the eyes of a 9th Boundary Layer existence as even though Oppenheimer was right there, neither the Dragoshark Prion Oxyrinchus nor the Noblesse Reverend Emperor could see him!
The Eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform could see through everything, and they could also mask everything!
The tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY were also kept at bay as Oppenheimer slowly rose and sat on the black earth while feeling shocking changes coursing through him.
Had others even imagined doing what he did?
Even if they tried to do it, they may not be successful!
After all, even the Noblesse could only chain the Eyes of Clarity and use them in a restricted fashion that barely utilized 10% of their power.
Yet Oppenheimer had managed to pull them while they were at their lowest as he had now gained an unprecedented boon.

As he sat on the black earth with tendrils of red and silver all around him, chaos unfolded as if it had nothing to do with him. Others couldn't even see him as he knew he would have time to absorb his gains...or it should have been so!
But, he felt a piercing gaze focus on his location as if it was over and above even Reverends.

His dark hair fluttered gloriously as when he turned his head, his new eyes locked onto this gaze right away as far from his position, the being who had adorned a cerulean visage briefly and destroyed the Aeonic Soul of a Reverend Noblesse could be seen.
His gaze locked onto his newly transplanted eyes as Oppenheimer became increasingly more cautious!
He felt endless power and possibilities in the other set of eyes as even the eyes of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform that was the True Emperor of Genesis felt a sharp sensation tug on them at this moment!

Destiny now swirled within them as feeling this unique and unknown situation unfold, Oppenheimer instantly made a move to consolidate his gains- his eyes releasing a blinding light as his figure buzzed with power, burrowing into the black earth below him as he silently went towards the direction of the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands silently.
He would first discern destiny and understand his enemy. Then he would make a move!
The inheritance of the Eyes of Clarity in Noah's own eyes died down as he saw Oppenheimer's figure disappear.
He sensed the connection and link between his current eyes and the Eyes Oppenheimer had just taken, many thoughts and possibilities emerging within his mind as he thought of this being!
There was chaos unfolding all around them, but nobody dared to near their position as even the Quasarian and Lernaean Reverend still floated in the distance carefully.

They were debating whether it was worth it amidst this chaos and the opportunity that lay behind them as after nanoseconds of deliberation...they swallowed their pride and this humiliation as they turned around to also go towards the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands all others were seeking!

Noah floated in the dark skies as his figure released pulses of power, Ophelia materializing with golden grandeur beside him as she marveled while her soft hands came to check his body all over, affirming what Wisdom told her as she could only shake her head.
<You've really reached the 9th Boundary Layer this easily? Ah...>
His talent was enough to make others question and despair as Ophelia sighed, collected her emotions, and maintained her image as she put all other thoughts aside and gazed around them with a smile.
<No matter, Sacrarium Master. What shall we do now amidst all this?>
In this state of increasing disorder, just how exactly would they move?!

Around Noah's True Sanguine Clone, tendrils of Dream, Avalon, Prana, Fantasia, Apollyon...all the essence of the Sources of Decreta began to bubble and form a shocking platform below his feet as they now carried traces of Extremity.
But this wasn't all.
There were also tendrils of Natural Laws surging below him to make the multicolored platform he floated on as one particular essence was wilder and more potent than all the others.
It was due to its nature and what currently unfolded around it as the essence Noah felt surging gleefully...was none other than Entropy!
In this reality of ever increasing chaos and disorder, Entropy should theoretically reign supreme as it was showing its wildness right now.

It caused Noah to give it more attention as along with the Boundary of Dimensions he had utilized the Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity on, this became his next target as his Will sent the commands right away.
There was bound to be immense wonders in the unfolding chaos as he would make use of it.

In regards to Ophelia's question, he knew that he needed time to consolidate his power and see just where he was at with the overabundance of information currently flowing through him due to Quintessence and the many changes it brought.
But at the same time, his eyes waded across the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands as he did not focus on the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity all others surged towards in the distance.
He looked...at the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans that all others were holding at bay and seeking to get past.
While others may consider them hindrances, to him...they're fantastical tonics and even more important than the Aeonic Treasures of Extremity!

Seeing their bodies surging with RUIN and NULLITY already in the form of Boundaries, Noah wondered what he could gain from them as he currently tried to obtain a precious few seconds to consolidate his gains and optimize his power!

chapters.title: Chapter 2318 Reverend! III
paragraphs: Waves of RUIN and NULLITY cascaded all around him as his eyes were filled with an overabundance of clarity.

His True Sanguine Clone had an even brighter luster of blue at this moment as Manadynamics surged powerfully around him, Quintessence propping it up and many more sources within Noah with utmost radiance!
Amidst all this chaos and battle, Noah calmly read everything before him as he spoke to Ophelia.
<It's messy and chaotic here while the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands hold unknown secrets. There will be even more Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans within as we can also make our way in...>

Most of the Reverends of the three different Lineages had forged forward as they're just part of the forces of some of the Civilizations booming within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, with the much greater level of importance now being placed in this location as events unfolded. This meant that even more Reverends and powerhouses of Lineages would be sent here as those who forged ahead and gained more would have a much easier time going forward!
Ophelia nodded at Noah's words as she continued to gaze at the ever flowing words of Wisdom, finding new traces of information that were never there before.
<The deeper we delve into these lands, the more dangerous it becomes. At some point, Wisdom says that locations that only Apex Aeonic Lifeforms can survive in may appear...>
Terrific words emanated from her as when Noah heard them, his smile only became brighter.
<Good.>
WAA!
Conquest and tyranny were roused within his heart as since he was becoming an utterly sharp blade at rapid speeds, he needed even more unimaginable opponents to keep this same speed!
Below his feet, the authorities of many newly expanded Boundaries surged as he carried a dense concentration of power while he began to float forward.

Ophelia floated behind her serenely as they looked like a pair of celestial organisms on a stroll, not a single being standing in their way at this moment as they began to edge deeper into the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
Across the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
In a location where roiling tendrils of RUIN the size of Realities swirled like endless snakes, a unique Minor Plane floated undaunted.

While tendrils of RUIN that would decimate Reverends as if they're mere meat on a chopping block churned, this Minor Plane of Existence ignored it all as it floated serenely, a unique power coursing over its boundary as it shone of stellar radiance and wonder!

And near the edge of this Plane, a sea of NULLITY that broke into a waterfall could be seen near its planar boundary, with two particularly dreadful auras actually being atop this sea as one sat on the edge of the sea of Nullity that transformed into a waterfall, while the other was at the very center of this silver sea as thick chains rose from it and wrapped tightly around his whole body.
Dark strands of hair shimmering with wonder cascaded past his shoulders as his eyes...they held mere sockets that shone like endless singularities as be stared out into the distance.

His skin shone with a fair radiance of wonder and power as it seemed indestructible even with the attacks of hundreds of Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer, everything about him emanating grace and power even though he was chained!

The being sitting at the edge of the waterfall of nullity had a curious expression on his face as he occasionally reached outside the barrier around this minor plane, his hands smoothly wrapping around the thick coiling tendrils of RUIN the size of Realities as he pulled them in as if he were fishing and....threw them towards his mouth as he devoured them whole.

This seemed to be his routine as if he had done this countless times, the massive Crimson rings around his limbs and head transparent and barely visible as his obsidian skin seemed to devour all forms of light as it put black holes to shame!
Everything seemed to be flowing as it normally should when all of a sudden, the chained existence with empty sockets emanated out a will that showed an aged voice full of tiredness.
<We were wrong.>
WAA!
His released will caused the sea of Nullity around him to seethe as the chains surging with Nullity and traces of crimson Ruin around him danced with a cacophony of noise!
<Hmm?>
The Noblesse Lifeform before the chained existence turned his head back with a smile, licking his lips as he finished yet another thick tendril of RUIN.
<O Genesis, what were we wrong about?>

His words seemed to carry genuine curiosity as if he were talking to a friend, and the one he referred to as Genesis stared out towards the expanse of tendrils of RUIN that released heavy waves of EXTREMITY as he continued with a sense of melancholy!

<Why do we continue to conflict and seek for more? When we arrived in the Havens of Extremity, we saw a vast world before us as we sought its power. We then gained more than enough power as we became Lifeforms that could traverse the Cracks of Extremity and even step foot into the other Aeonic Havens...only to find even grander lands and even more powerful beings. It's just...>
His head shook as he spoke, the tiredness and melancholy ever present in his words as he continued!

<Those in the Firmaments of Ascendancy perish. Those expanding Boundaries towards Extremity perish. Even beings like you and me who have attained a stage to be called Apex Aeonic Lifeforms perish. Just...look at me. Chained here for the past billion years as what about me screams Apex? What about me screams a higher life form?>

A great deal of despondency emanated out as his words actually caused the smile on the Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeform to fade, a somber expression coming down as even this being turned around to stare into the expanse of crimson tendrils before them!
He did not deny what Genesis said- nay, he could not deny it as this being's feelings were actually not too far off!

chapters.title: Chapter 2319 Reverend! IV
paragraphs: <We were wrong about all of it at the very beginning, O Agathocles. The opening of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands in the Haven of Dissolution should have told you the same thing. We...should've never sought Extremity. The more we seek it, the more it draws near...and yet still infinitely far away. You will never reach it. I'll never reach it. And even if a stroke of Destiny came and we did reach it...what then? Will you finally be happy? Will you finally stop? Or will you simply realize that within Extremity, there exists something even far greater?>
Crimson RUIN crackled and destroyed the fabric of Nature outside the floating Minor Plane as if denying the words of the True Emperor of Genesis!
Yet this being whose eyes were dug out seemed to see a whole lot more as he sighed while he continued.

<When we became Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, we thought we would have more freedom as instead, we only became more shackled. We were told to fight tooth and nail to reach Extremity...invited to join Forces we never knew existed as we left our Lineage designations. Those of us who denied were cast out and left to fend for ourselves as I came to realize...the selfish nature of organisms never changes no matter what stage of power they achieve.>
WAA!

<We always seek our own benefits. We always desire things for ourselves as cycles of hatred and chaos are sown no matter what stage we are at. War and chaos are ever present no matter where you go as if it's all the same...what meaning is there, Agathocles? When all I can see at the end of this path is merely our own ruin? When even in the baptism of Extremity, there is still death? Under the weight of Extremity, all of us are bound to perish...whether we reach it or not.>
BOOM!
The sea of NULLITY beneath him seethed with even more entropy as the thick tendrils of RUIN outside the Minor Plane formed into mountains that crashed down with immense ferocity!
Silence descended onto these lands as desolation was the only thing felt, the Noblesse Apex Lifeform known as Agathocles sighing even more as he continued to stare out into the Crimson blackness.
He had no words.
After all, they had exchanged too many words over the years.
Agathocles was silent as he spoke lightly after a few seconds passed.
<Have you reached it after all these years?>
A simple question that only Genesis understood as without a second delay, he nodded slowly as his Will emanated out once more.
<I've made some progress.>

Agathocles said nothing at this affirmation as he simply reached his hand out to grab even more tendrils of RUIN, gazing at them within his hands as they roared out chaotically while behind him, the massive chains of NULLITY and RUIN that had endlessly sunk into the Aspects of Existence of the True Emperor of Genesis began to crack and splinter into countless silver snowflakes.

<We were born from nothing, we remain nothing, and we'll return to nothing. We shall all perish under the weight of Extremity, but on my end...there are wrongs I must right before I perish. There are too many regrets.>
A light of profundity and wonder thundered out madly from the words of the True Emperor of Genesis as everything around him seethed chaotically!

The chains that dug deep into his soul cracked and disappeared as if they're nothing, his massive figure that took a significant portion of the Minor Plane they were one rising as if he had never been chained.

Agathocles did not even turn around as the countless chains broke and the visage of Genesis rose, his feet dangling and feeling the surging waterfall of Nullity cascading down as his eyes carried mixed emotions.
The two beings stared out into the expanse of crimson ruin as the visage of Genesis soon began to flicker, space folding in on itself as within moments, he disappeared.
The only thing he left behind were a set of words.
<You were great company for all these years, Agathocles.>
SHAA!
With that, the True Emperor of Genesis was gone.
Unshackled and unbound as he had reached an even greater stage of profundity!
Agathocles continued to stare out past the boundary of the Minor Plane as his eyes trembled at this moment, a calm voice emanating from him as he sighed.

<The lands always seem too grand and never ending. We thought the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution was it as later on, we find there are Seven Aeonic Havens with established Civilizations that have been there for trillions of years. I...was getting too tired of it all anyways. So thank you, Genesis.>
His eyes trembled even more as his radiant transparent Crimson Halos began to fracture and shatter.

His skin then fissured and had countless cracks bloom as this being that exuded the immense life force of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...instantly began to seem like a desiccated corpse as all signs of life were slowly fading away from him!
His very origin was destroyed long ago when Genesis had begun speaking, with Agathocles only realizing halfway through that he was already dead!
The profundity of RUIN and NULLITY within him that he believed in so much could do nothing to stop it.

So he became calm and listened to the words of the being he had personally dug the eyes out of and watched as focused RUIN and NULLITY surged into his vessels for many years while his Aspects of Existence should have been entirely shackled and unable to resist.
But at the end of it all, this being actually reached an even greater stage of profundity as with a single move, he extinguished the origin of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!

The massive body of the Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeform began to flicker and turn into stellar dust that was flushed away by the raging waterfall of nullity, the eyes of this being closing peacefully as his Will emanated out for the last time.
<I hope you find your peace...Genesis.>
HOONG!
Essence seethed as his whole being turned into dust.

From the position he was in, a blinding singularity was left behind as some of the dust clustered around it, releasing a blinding radiance that very soon accumulated to pulse with a dreadfully potent aura of an Aeonic Treasure of Extremity!
Thereafter, everything returned to serenity in this Minor Plane.
The only thing that had changed...was one particular Apex Aeonic Lifeform becoming unchained after a significant number of years!

sentences.text: <We were wrong about all of it at the very beginning, O Agathocles.
The opening of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands in the Haven of Dissolution should have told you the same thing.
We...should've never sought Extremity.
The more we seek it, the more it draws near...and yet still infinitely far away.
You will never reach it.
I'll never reach it.
And even if a stroke of Destiny came and we did reach it...what then?
Will you finally be happy?
Will you finally stop?
Or will you simply realize that within Extremity, there exists something even far greater?>
Crimson RUIN crackled and destroyed the fabric of Nature outside the floating Minor Plane as if denying the words of the True Emperor of Genesis!
Yet this being whose eyes were dug out seemed to see a whole lot more as he sighed while he continued.
<When we became Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, we thought we would have more freedom as instead, we only became more shackled.
We were told to fight tooth and nail to reach Extremity...invited to join Forces we never knew existed as we left our Lineage designations.
Those of us who denied were cast out and left to fend for ourselves as I came to realize...the selfish nature of organisms never changes no matter what stage of power they achieve.>
WAA!
<We always seek our own benefits.
We always desire things for ourselves as cycles of hatred and chaos are sown no matter what stage we are at.
War and chaos are ever present no matter where you go as if it's all the same...what meaning is there, Agathocles?
When all I can see at the end of this path is merely our own ruin?
When even in the baptism of Extremity, there is still death?
Under the weight of Extremity, all of us are bound to perish...whether we reach it or not.>
BOOM!
The sea of NULLITY beneath him seethed with even more entropy as the thick tendrils of RUIN outside the Minor Plane formed into mountains that crashed down with immense ferocity!
Silence descended onto these lands as desolation was the only thing felt, the Noblesse Apex Lifeform known as Agathocles sighing even more as he continued to stare out into the Crimson blackness.
He had no words.
After all, they had exchanged too many words over the years.
Agathocles was silent as he spoke lightly after a few seconds passed.
<Have you reached it after all these years?>
A simple question that only Genesis understood as without a second delay, he nodded slowly as his Will emanated out once more.
<I've made some progress.>

Agathocles said nothing at this affirmation as he simply reached his hand out to grab even more tendrils of RUIN, gazing at them within his hands as they roared out chaotically while behind him, the massive chains of NULLITY and RUIN that had endlessly sunk into the Aspects of Existence of the True Emperor of Genesis began to crack and splinter into countless silver snowflakes.
<We were born from nothing, we remain nothing, and we'll return to nothing.
We shall all perish under the weight of Extremity, but on my end...there are wrongs I must right before I perish.
There are too many regrets.>
A light of profundity and wonder thundered out madly from the words of the True Emperor of Genesis as everything around him seethed chaotically!

The chains that dug deep into his soul cracked and disappeared as if they're nothing, his massive figure that took a significant portion of the Minor Plane they were one rising as if he had never been chained.

Agathocles did not even turn around as the countless chains broke and the visage of Genesis rose, his feet dangling and feeling the surging waterfall of Nullity cascading down as his eyes carried mixed emotions.
The two beings stared out into the expanse of crimson ruin as the visage of Genesis soon began to flicker, space folding in on itself as within moments, he disappeared.
The only thing he left behind were a set of words.
<You were great company for all these years, Agathocles.>
SHAA!
With that, the True Emperor of Genesis was gone.
Unshackled and unbound as he had reached an even greater stage of profundity!
Agathocles continued to stare out past the boundary of the Minor Plane as his eyes trembled at this moment, a calm voice emanating from him as he sighed.
<The lands always seem too grand and never ending.
We thought the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution was it as later on, we find there are Seven Aeonic Havens with established Civilizations that have been there for trillions of years.
I...was getting too tired of it all anyways.
So thank you, Genesis.>
His eyes trembled even more as his radiant transparent Crimson Halos began to fracture and shatter.

His skin then fissured and had countless cracks bloom as this being that exuded the immense life force of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform...instantly began to seem like a desiccated corpse as all signs of life were slowly fading away from him!
His very origin was destroyed long ago when Genesis had begun speaking, with Agathocles only realizing halfway through that he was already dead!
The profundity of RUIN and NULLITY within him that he believed in so much could do nothing to stop it.

So he became calm and listened to the words of the being he had personally dug the eyes out of and watched as focused RUIN and NULLITY surged into his vessels for many years while his Aspects of Existence should have been entirely shackled and unable to resist.
But at the end of it all, this being actually reached an even greater stage of profundity as with a single move, he extinguished the origin of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!

The massive body of the Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeform began to flicker and turn into stellar dust that was flushed away by the raging waterfall of nullity, the eyes of this being closing peacefully as his Will emanated out for the last time.
<I hope you find your peace...Genesis.>
HOONG!
Essence seethed as his whole being turned into dust.

From the position he was in, a blinding singularity was left behind as some of the dust clustered around it, releasing a blinding radiance that very soon accumulated to pulse with a dreadfully potent aura of an Aeonic Treasure of Extremity!
Thereafter, everything returned to serenity in this Minor Plane.
The only thing that had changed...was one particular Apex Aeonic Lifeform becoming unchained after a significant number of years!

chapters.title: Chapter 2320 Reverend! V
paragraphs: Indomitable power coursed through him as he engrossed constant waves of information while over 20 new concepts were expanded towards Extremity, each one holding its own uniqueness that could fill up countless pages.
But the most important one currently remained the core value that he brought up to the 9th Boundary Layer- Quintessence!
He perused its details as he accepted the fact that somehow, he had truly reached the stage that those in the Havens of Extremity designated the experts of as Reverend!
He was now a Reverend as he shared a profound sense of power, but...he did not want to be alone in this feeling.
He had others he cared for. He wanted the same happiness he felt to also be experienced by them.
So his Will surged.
His focus was placed on the Dream Dimensional Chassis that had arrived in the Abecedarian Sacrarium and were seeing its vastness with Ophelia in the lead.

They had moved from the Observatory as they currently floated in a junction of this Plane of Existence that had a nexus of stellar Rivers of Reality joining together, with all of them currently floating within a region of stellar purple gold dust that bloomed from a dying singularity.

Noah gazed at the people he had been through many journeys with as he exceeded them greatly in power in a short period of time- going from Adelaide who helped him in the Beast World, to the Kraken Atlantis, to Barbatos in the Demon World, to the Cthulhu and other Terrors of his Universe, to Lancelot of the Avalon Dimension...all the way to Eowyn and what at the time were ridiculous capabilities with Absolute Dream Authority, Guinevere, Arthus, Oldest Dream- and many others!
He thought of all of this as he then looked towards Ophelia.
An existence currently at the same stage of power as him as who knew how much time would pass before Noah exceeded everything she knew?
He had boundless levels of power and glory, but it did not have to be contained within him as he could always share it with those he cared about!
<I've always grappled with how to best provide you all with the same level of glory and power I experience daily. How to let you all have your own identities and goals if you wished to pursue them.>
His voice emanated out suddenly as all his people that were moving around and staring at the wonders around them while adapting to the heavy aura of Extremity stopped to look towards him.
Ophelia stopped talking as well as she listened with a meaningful smile as Noah continued, his gaze coming to land on Barbatos.
<The Necromancer of Chaos, the Demon Lord that conjured Legions of Undead.>
WAA!
His words caused Barbatos's small figure to rise with power and intensity as his eyes turned towards another direction and continued!
<Tiamat, the Dragon Progenitor that reigned over Lineages of Dragons.>
<Dimensional Rulers of Minor Planes of Existence themselves.>
<The Great Usurper that tears through the veils of Dimensions...>
Noah gazed at multiple organisms and called out their names and titles as after gazing at a certain amount...he addressed them all grandly.
<Do you all desire your names to ring out from the souls of countless organisms once more? To be echoed out in the vastness of Extremity?>

Utmost radiance shone around him as he waved his hands to reveal hundreds of dazzling singularities that were Complete Golden Aeonic Pearls of Extremity, with a few Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity mixed in.
Just a fraction of the Loot he had gained from his single attack on the Legions of Noblesse, Lernaeans, and Quasarians!

Loot that granted 3 Boundary Layers to any concept as he had no need for hundreds of them when all Sources bound to him were already being passively elevated by his Boundary of Quintessence at this very moment.
So he laid out these halcyon singularities as he continued!

<It's all possible with the vastness of Extremity- with the vastness of the Havens of Extremity that would take time for even I to cover everything. If you so choose, take these Pearls of Extremity. And once you do...you shall stretch out across this Aeonic Haven of Dissolution and spread word of Quintessence. Spread your names and titles, spread your grandeur and glory, but most of all...spread the tyranny of conquest of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor.>
HUUM!
Boundless waves of light and power emanated from him as in the silence, the cry of an Emperor Penguin bellowed out!
CAA!
He was the first to surge forward and swallow a cluster of Pearls of Extremity, with the visage of the Blue Slime following next as Eowyn, Kazuhiko, Barbatos, and all others followed!

During all of this, Henry floated near his father as he watched the magnificence before his eyes as soon after, Noah turned to stare at him as 9 Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity appeared before him, along with tens of Complete Golden Aeonic Pearls of Extremity as Noah locked his grand gaze with his progeny.
<My son.>
WAA!
Arcs of Destiny and glory flashed as Henry gazed at his father with endless trust and wonder.

<When you were born, Destiny seethed torrentially as you were proclaimed the Child of Destiny. Prove this title and exceed it. I'll give you the means...and I want you to deliver to me the Domains of Noblesse in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.>
<Our Lineage is not one that simply follows, and you must make a name as an Emperor yourself that others will cry out across the Havens of Extremity.>
There were multiple Sacrariums of the Ancestral Lernaeans to see.
An unknown number of domains under the Noblesse and Quasarians.
Noah would spread his forces across its domains while he himself ventured into the depths of Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
His words were heard loud and clear as Henry gazed back at him and nodded with power.
<Yes, Father!>

The features of a child were long gone from Henry as he lost the designation of <Little>, this existence ready to try and forge his own path when the shadow that his father cast...was immeasurably hard to overcome!
