chapters.title: Chapter 2321 Reverend! VI
paragraphs: Waves of Destiny spread out madly as among the many organisms here, Noah also turned his head to see a friend.

He gazed at the visage of Eckert surrounded by Europa and a group of women he was not entirely familiar with as he asked the Great Usurper that he also offered a few dozen Complete Golden Aeonic Pearls of Extremity and a few Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity.
<What shall you do?>
The Great Usurper and his own anomalous path. Just which direction would he now follow?
Eckert smiled at Noah's question as he gazed out into the blackness of stellar light and replied lightly.
<There should be more than this Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, right? I shall also head out and forge my own name and path. Maybe I'll find what I seek in Extremity.>

What did the Great Usurper seek? With his path of domination and idleness, just what would the Havens of Extremity provide for him? Nobody knew what the future held, but the aura of Boundaries whipped around him and those nearby as decisions were made.
Paths were chosen.
Choices were made.
No matter what occurred in the future though, Quintessence was bound to spread!
Quintessence.
Noah repeated this concept over and over again as he now gazed at the neatly formulated details of its upper layers.

It was said in the past that the closer one went towards Extremity, the more that paths converged as a single concept could very well act offensively, defensively, and have its own auxiliary features.

Concepts of Seers or Augurs who expanded Destiny, Fate, or Wisdom did not mean they would have low fight power, where apart from their foresight- their future Boundary Layers had their own variation of deadly offensive capabilities!
The closer one went towards Extremity, the more that all paths and concepts converged.

<The Eighth Boundary Layer of Quintessence>:: Your Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul has already integrated to all parts of you and achieved Aeonic Soul Sublimation. Quintessence wants to take things a step further and begin your transformation into an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, the effects of passive Soul Refinement and Strengthening being boosted to a Quintessential level as in addition to the augmentation of +1,000% provided by the 5th Boundary Layer of Quintessence, the augmentation of +10,000% to All Aeonic Parameter Values is granted with this Boundary Layer...

<The Ninth Boundary Layer of Quintessence>:: An important threshold has been crossed as Quintessence Quintessence begins to proliferate to the reality around you. Up to 9 Boundaries can now be deemed Quintessential as all the Boundaries deemed Quintessential can now be passively elevated an additional Layer for a total of Three Quintessential Apocryphal Layers. The only limitation is the application of the Quintessential Apocryphal Layers being applicable only to the highest level that Quintessence itself has reached. As Quintessence becomes more pervasive, your authority over multiple areas also increases as your authority to peer into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity is further expanded with its cost reduced. Your distinction as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator becomes even more pristine as you can manipulate your presently unfolding history that is being written in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity with even more ease. Quintessence nudges you forward to inform you that with its efforts in elevating your Soul and this expanded authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator, the time has come for you to expand it and all others to the Consummate Boundary Tier...
Pure glory was in the details of the 8th and 9th Boundary Layers of Quintessence as they opened the path forward.
An expansion to what the designation of Quintessential would do!
An expansion to the authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator!

When he looked at the abundant information, Noah knew that all he had to do was utilize a single Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity to expand a Boundary to have 6 True Boundary Layers, and the moment he deemed them Quintessential to apply the Three Quintessential Apocryphal Layers...they would reach the 9th Boundary Layer!
It meant that in the next few moments, Loot could reach the 9th Boundary Layer.
Blood could reach the 9th Boundary Layer.
Dimensions and Entropy could reach the 9th Boundary Layer!

9 chosen Boundaries could ridiculously be expanded to such a high stage where only the most powerful of Reverends had reached across the Civilizations of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution- the only exceptions being Anomalous Entities and existence truly attune with Extremity.
This...was why Quintessence paved the way forward.
·ƈθm It was the first to reach the 9th Boundary Layer, and yet its first influence could bring 9 other Boundaries to its level.
Another was to grant Noah the power and authority to reforge his Boundaries to the Consummate Level!

Billowing waves of multicolored grandeur overflowed from the visage of his Dream Dimensional Chassis s he oversaw his people beginning to emit waves of Extremity, his son to his right erupting with the light of the Boundary of Loot, Quintessence, and Blood beside him as his handsome figure showed abundant regality.
Adelaide calmly watched to his left as she didn't rush forward to consume the Pearls of Extremity.
She knew herself well and what she wanted as she was a Queen.
Her King would grant her even more than this as she did not need to put herself on the front lines, so she only smiled as she watched the unfolding grandeur before her.
Such a scene was et ceterahed in Noah's mind as he began to send out multiple commands with his very soul.
The first command...was the deactivation of the effects of Quintessence on the Boundaries of Loot, Blood, Dimensions, and Entropy among others as they all showed only their true layers.

He then devoured multiple Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity as all these Boundaries would be propelled to the 6th Boundary Layer, and after this was achieved...he would designate them Quintessential and instantly bring them to the 9th Boundary Layer!
And at the same time...a terrific light of the authority of the Quintessential Aeonic Curator began to shine as he wanted to see.
He wanted to see just what a Boundary at the Consummate level entailed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2322 Across The Lands! I
paragraphs: An eerie calm settled.

Under the manipulated flow of time in the Source of Reality, Noah's body aptly controlled the surging flows of essence as after the eruption of radiance from Quintessence reaching the 9th Boundary Layer and multiple other concepts being expanded towards Extremity, he pulled everything towards his main body as his skin was the only thing releasing a blazing contained luster.

Any radiance that erupted out shone on his fair stellar skin as he currently had a wild visage, his figure continuing its transformation constantly as his sense of beauty and handsomeness became more and more otherworldly!
The closer one was towards Extremity, the more pristine and glorious they became.

The number of high quality concepts they had going towards Extremity counted as well- with Noah having an obscene number that propelled his soul forward as his Aeonic Soul Values broke past 800,000 seconds ago and continued ascending without stopping!

Such a high number was the reason his authority as the Aeonic Quintessential Curator was expanded, where it was a long way away from the few thousand he initially had when he altered his Recorded History to make all his Boundaries at the Crimson Innate Boundary level.
So when he initiated Aeonic Quintessential Curator right now, he expected grand changes as his Main Body closed its eyes, containing the radiance within as his soul was taken to another location!
A location that was extremely far away and also unimaginably very close.

The distance of such a place did not matter as it could be accessed normally so long as one had a Consummate Boundary at the Seventh Boundary Layer or more- it was the fringes of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!

Radiance overflowed as he delved deeper into the fringes easily now, his soul that much stronger as he saw the Runic Ecritures forming into pillars of multicolored light, and around these pillars...the same stellar golden, Obsidian, and Crimson colored scrolls floated in space calmly as they contained everything about him.
The golden scrolls had the designation of [Genesis], the obsidian scrolls had the destination of [Chrysalis], and the stellar crimson scrolls that remained utterly empty were labeled [Extremity].

A massive ancient-looking obsidian scroll unfurled as dazzling details showed themselves.

Quintessence had promised him so as at this moment, his will locked onto it as he focused on its details.

An array of details cascaded down as Noah stopped at the very first sentence of this Boundary.
And then...the authority of the Aeonic Quintessential Curator was activated as his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul began to surge out torrentially towards the concept of Quintessence!
Last time, he burned a few hundred Soul Values to reach the tier of Obsidian Innate and a few thousand to reach Crimson Innate.
At this moment...over 100,000 Aeonic Soul Values surged forward like a massive tide as they weren't alone.
His Aeonic Mana of Extremity also burned with cerulean grandeur as since he was using his Aeonic Soul Value...it would also do its best to make up any differences it was allowed to!

It meant that tidal waves of cerulean majesty also descended onto the Boundary of Quintessence as Noah attacked its designation, beginning to erase the words Crimson Innate and beginning to forge the words Golden Consummate as he directly altered his Recorded History!
As he directly changed the reality of the Tier of his Boundary from what it was into something else entirely.
HOONG!

A booming sound erupted as it felt like a portion of his Soul exploded- but this was simply the abrupt and shocking change at a grand scale occurring right away just like before...Quintessence led the way forward.
It was just that...the changes this time would be too grand!
In the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.

Noah's True Sanguine Clone was floating towards its depths past the torn veil with Ophelia following closely beside him, their auras being noticed by many as the closer they appeared to the periphery of the stellar mountains and fantastical landscapes- even the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans floating in this region begun to gaze towards their direction!
And yet at this moment before they delved in too deep...
BZZZT!

The potent aura of Extremity in the surroundings and across this initial area of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands pulsed in a shocking manner as this dense aura...began to surge towards none other than Noah's figure.

His visage began to give off a shocking feel and aura of Extremity as such a phenomenon was very quickly recognized- especially so by a few specific Quasarians who had managed to grasp something similar!
It was...the air of an existence achieving a Consummate Boundary!

chapters.title: Chapter 2323 Across The Lands! II
paragraphs: The pervasive pressure of Extremity across the Havens of Extremity was transparent and formless as it pressed down on everything.

In the case of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, it was even more focused and dreadful to the extent that existences who had only come as far as achieving the Sixth Boundary Layer in a concept had a hard time just walking across these lands!
Only those at the Eighth Boundary Layer and above could move freely or even manage to float across this space- with these restrictions only increasing the deeper one went.
This was one of the secrets of this domain and why these lands were places where Aeonic Treasures of Extremity could bloom!
One of them was this immense pressure of Extremity, and the other...was the Extremity Vein of Dissolution coursing somewhere within these Lands.

And at this moment, the palpable pressure descending on everyone could be seen actually being absorbed by a single being- with the very nearby mountains of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands pulsing with radiance as it seemed like a whirling transparent storm formed with a single figure at the very center absorbing everything.

His figure gave off an abrupt increase in grace and power as he began to emanate a potent aura of Extremity- something that only beings like Prince Zagugan and Reverend Emperor Septimius gave off on this field of battle currently!
One of the most powerful beings here- Reverend Emperor Septimius, turned around from the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands he had reached as his gaze became solemn at this moment.
The Quasarians were the only Lineage apart from the fourth Lineage full of secrets and mystery in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution that had a Consummate Boundary.
The Noblesse did not have one. The Ancestral Lernaeans didn't have one.
Only they and the unique Civilization that seemed to have walked these lands for many years before they came held something as pristine as a Consummate Boundary as it distinguished them in power!

Even though it was not a Boundary all Quasarians could learn as it had the prerequisite of an existence needing to achieve at least the 7th Boundary Layer before they could expand the First Layer of the Consummate Boundary- it was still something that even made their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms utterly dreadful.
To see an existence who seemed linked to the Ancestral Lernaeans show off an aura of such a Boundary?
It did not evoke any good feelings in the soul of Quasarians!
At the same time, the Ancestral Lernaeans gazed at this scene and the visage of Ophelia near this being as their complex expressions were filled with doubt and happiness!

If they cleared up whatever misunderstanding this situation around them caused, it meant that their Lineage of Ancestral Lernaeans had produced a Consummate Boundary and could move forward even further!
HOONG!

A brilliant multicolored pillar of light shot out with the figure of the True Emperor of Quintessence at the center, the potent aura of Extremity barreling into him as one could see pieces of his skin bursting and disappearing as even more radiant skin bloomed.
An air of immense power and Tyranny surged out as before his eyes...
<The Golden Consummate Boundary of Quintessence has been born.>
A fantastical prompt appeared.
And the moment it did, the birth of a Consummate Boundary was cemented as those he had allowed to learn it...
BZZT!
...Also shared in his glory as beside him, Ophelia also gave off a terrifying wave of power as even she gazed towards Noah in shock!
Even Wisdom did not foretell this as her light brown radiant skin was replaced by an even grander layer of brilliance!
Amidst all of this, the man beside her sensed the profound aura of Extremity he carried as he...took a single step in the skies.

And his figure instantly disappeared as apart from just being able to fly in this restricted space, he could now even twist the spacetime continuum to appear from one location to another as he instantly got past the torn veil that others had just crossed while putting their lives on the line.
His actions roused the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans as a few that floated grandly atop stellar mountains holding Aeonic Treasures of Extremity roared out in low tones.
But...he was not done.

·ƈθm Even before the potent aura of Extremity from a single Boundary reaching the Consummate Tier was done, his figure blared out again as this time, a golden pillar of light joined the multicolored one to shine around him!

It caused the jaws of the Myriad of Boundary Expansion Realm experts here who were still following what this meant to almost drop on the stellar black floor as it showed...a second concept also reaching the tier of Consummate at this very moment within this being!

It was unimaginable as once more before the eyes of this being, another prompt rose as behind the scenes, hundreds of thousands of Aeonic Soul Values whipped from his soul to change his Recorded History as an even more obscene amount of Aeonic Mana of Extremity accompanied this process.
<The Golden Consummate Boundary of Loot has been born.>
WAA!

A halcyon light accompanied the multicolored pillar of light around him as the air of Extremity he gave off became even more concentrated, his visage feeling stifling to others as he released an air of wildness akin to the Leviathans who lived in these lands since ancient times!
ROAAR!
His rising aura of Extremity caused many eyes to lock onto him as the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans felt like their prestige and dominion were threatened- deep roars booming out.

And an instant later, an Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan moved with pristine glory- a creature with the name of <Varicella Emperor Kong> booming out as it looked like a Celestial ape with black and Crimson fur, it's massive limbs crashing down like two mountains towards Noah's figure as they pulsed with seas of RUIN and NULLITY!
The Varicella Emperor Kong arrived in an instant to appear before him, and yet what he did next caused the hearts of many organisms here to lurch.
Against the oncoming limbs that seemed like mountains that could shatter an average 9th Boundary Layer expert, he rose a single hand upwards as the moment it arrived....
PAAH!

Space buzzed, fissured, and cracked all once as the unstoppable force that the Varicella Emperor Kong had displayed was actually received and dispelled in an instant with what seemed to be the force of his body alone.
His visage looked utterly dominating and majestic at this moment as immense silence reigned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2324 Across The Lands! III
paragraphs: Oppressive.
Mighty!

This was the sense of awe and wonder that the True Emperor of Quintessence currently showed as his figure continued absorbing the potent aura of Extremity, the pressure he released only building up more and more as his power rose to the extent that with his hand alone...he could rebuff the strike of a creature that oppressed average Reverends!
Others may look at this with sheer disbelief, but to some of the most powerful organisms here, they understood the power that an Aeonic Soul Sublimation expert could achieve.
They knew that at that point, the Soul was fully integrated into all aspects of Existence as any part of one's body could display their strongest capabilities!

So Noah stopping the mountainous limbs of the Varicella Emperor Kong smashing down with his bare hand was also something that could have been replication if he cast a Barrier or Defensive Shield- or anything that could display his power.
But of course, it remained an astonishing scene as it showed just what the immensity of the boons were currently unfolding as Noah made way for Consummate Boundaries!
A heavy aura that made others feel stifled!
Oppenheimer stared at such a being closely now while he stood near a radiant mountain to the left of where boundless chaos currently unfolded.
The eyes of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform in his sockets were supposed to analyze and break down his secrets like all others, but...
Oppenheimer squinted and became somber.

When he now gazed at the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans or the most powerful organisms under the Quasarians, Ancestral Lernaeans, and Noblesse- he could very clearly see their identities and destiny as the Eyes of Clarity unveiled it all easily!
But with this being...no information that wasn't already known could be obtained!
Even with the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, he couldn't see this being's details or destiny!
The only thing...was what was already known by him as he affirmed his suspicions.
<The True Emperor of Quintessence>.
The one who had risen from the very same Barren Lands he came from as he foiled what he had planned with these Planes of Existence.
He should've been many billions of years younger, and yet he was somehow releasing the air of Consummate Boundaries at this moment as he seemed to equal or exceed average Reverends!
It only showed how much of an anomaly this being was.

Throughout his life, Oppenheimer had seen and overcome special existences with unimaginable destinies. Chosen Emperors and Destined Emperors- organisms meant for greatness...and he exceeded them when he was not anywhere close to their destined fortune!
But...he hadn't met a being like this.

And this was moreso affirmed as while this existence rebuffed the strike of a Varicella Emperor Kong, his austere body giving off waves of potent aura of Extremity didn't pour attention into the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan tight before him as his eyes gazed over the radiant mountains outstretched before him, only for his gaze to land on and focus on the mountain that Oppenheimer currently stood beside!
The dazzling eyes of this being releasing a providential aura felt like they locked with his eyes again even though he should be invisible and unseen to others as Oppenheimer sighed.

Destiny told him that his only opportunity here were the Eyes of Clarity as attaining anything else was off the table, but he still wanted to try after obtaining the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as he delved deeper into the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.
He now affirmed why no opportunity here was his as staying here...was too dangerous when this anomaly was showing himself!
He...had to do what he did before.
Learn about his enemy.
Understand him better than he understood himself.
Only then...would he be victorious.
HOONG!
He turned and gazed at the aura of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity around him as without a second of a delay, the spatial continuum around him twisted as he took a step.
He instantly traversed a vast distance to instantly appear past the area of the torn veil as he left the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.

He saw the deadly eyes of the anomalous being shockingly turn to follow him as he seemed ready to give a chase when the roar of another Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan boomed out- a second one of these Beasts arriving to besiege him as Oppenheimer only observed this scene and did not look back as he took the dark skies of the Abyss!

The same skies that many other Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans were flying up to leave the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity and spread outwards for the purpose of Extremity Sanctification.

Oppenheimer's figure quickly followed this path to ascend out of the Abyss- something that all those at the 7th Boundary Layer and below would find impossible for them to do in the very near future as only truly powerful 8th Boundary Layer Existences and above could leave the Abyss after they had entered.
A glow of clarity covered him as he trusted in the senses that got him where he was today.
He left the lands others considered a great opportunity instantly as the enemy that had locked onto him currently...he was someone that needed a great deal of planning to face!
There were other abundant opportunities with the Eyes of Clarity stemming from an Apex Aeonic Lifeform he now held.
With them...he even felt like he could cross the walls of the Aeonic Havens that only Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could traverse!
So...he would seek destiny carefully as he moved.
His eyes turned around to the Abyss one last time as he continued to see the radiance of this being, his eyes solemn as he disappeared while leaving behind simple words.
<Wait for me, O True Emperor of Quintessence.>
With a glimmer of unseen light, Oppenheimer disappeared as he left this region!

And past the torn veil, the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence only released grander radiance as a third light of crimson Consummate brilliance shone at this moment that caused all others to be gobsmacked!

A glow of clarity covered him as he trusted in the senses that got him where he was today.
He left the lands others considered a great opportunity instantly as the enemy that had locked onto him currently...he was someone that needed a great deal of planning to face!
There were other abundant opportunities with the Eyes of Clarity stemming from an Apex Aeonic Lifeform he now held.
With them...he even felt like he could cross the walls of the Aeonic Havens that only Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could traverse!
So...he would seek destiny carefully as he moved.
His eyes turned around to the Abyss one last time as he continued to see the radiance of this being, his eyes solemn as he disappeared while leaving behind simple words.
<Wait for me, O True Emperor of Quintessence.>
With a glimmer of unseen light, Oppenheimer disappeared as he left this region!

And past the torn veil, the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence only released grander radiance as a third light of crimson Consummate brilliance shone at this moment that caused all others to be gobsmacked!

chapters.title: Chapter 2325 Across The Lands! IV
paragraphs: A multicolored and golden radiance had surrounded him as they represented two Consummate Boundaries from their pristine pressure, with this alone causing Reverends to turn solemn and pay even greater attention to this being...but he was not done!
While the Varicella Emperor Kong was stopped by his right hand as he seemed like he was holding off an obsidian crimson mounting, another Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathan attacked.
It was a massive verdant spider with white stripes that had the dazzling destination of <Arachnoid Prion Queen> as it released a web of crimson silver light that could encompass all of reality.
And at such a moment, a crimson pillar of light was added to Noah as yet another prompt appeared.
<The Golden Consummate Boundary of Blood has been born.>
Golden!

This was the only stage of Consummate Noah could currently achieve as it was a heavy jump from the tier of Innate to Consummate, where he knew to take his concepts from Golden Consummate to Obsidian and later Crimson Consummate would be something he would struggle to do for the days and weeks to come.

But he felt his power scaling upwards once more as his used-up Aeonic Soul Values were forcefully being regenerated just as rapidly as he was using them, his left hand rising towards the encompassing web of RUIN and NULLITY as scathing cerulean flames composed of Infinity symbols bloomed to hold back the Arachnoid Prion Queen and its attack.

Two creatures exceeding average levels of power of Reverends attacked him as he rebuffed both of them at the same time, his Main Body beginning to peruse the shocking changes brought by his Boundaries being taken to the Consummate Tier as his True Sanguine Clone here...he could allow it to go wild to feel this power in real time!
<WOOO!>

Towards the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans releasing an air of wildness and brutality, he bellowed out with a royal air of tyranny and even greater wildness as his right hand clamped onto the crimson black fur of the Varicella Emperor Kong, his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul expressing its power through his body as he fantastically applied force and moved the towering mountain that attacked him as if it was an object that could be lifted.
BZZT!

Reality cracked and fissured as while bellowing out, he was actually capable of moving the body of the Varicella Emperor Kong as he hoisted such a mountainous creature and chucked it towards the Arachnoid Prion Queen!

His figure then barreled towards the both of them with shocking vigor and celestial stellar might as he seemed like a creature even more ancient and wild than them- a creature forged in the pressure of Extremity for an unknown number of years!
The endless stretches of the Aeonic Haven of Extremity seemed insurmountable for some, but eventually, even they had an end to those truly powerful.
Eventually, one could see their defined borders, where they began- and where they ended.
In the deepest reaches of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution that even the Ancestral Lerneans had not yet reached.

A massive concentration of potent essence of Extremity formed into a hazy billowing fog that seemed like a sentient entity that could swallow any beings below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms with ease.

This billowing fog stretched out linearly in all directions as right at the point where it connected to the skies and the vibrant earth, incandescent Aeonic Treasures of Extremity grew in abundance as they sparkled with pristine radiance.
They were forged over an unknown period of time as the potent aura of Extremity transformed even common herbs into profound wonders.

At this moment, the billowing cloud that was simply part of a massive spacetime continuum barrier began to roil and flicker as in one particular area, it began to open up as a verdant light shone through!

A light...of pristine wonder and closeness towards Extremity as it seemed to be almost there- a light of an Apex Aeonic Life Form that held such volume and breadth that it could encompass all other Lifeforms with ease!
HOOONG!

Such a light blared out as the unmovable fog that nobody below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could traverse parted, an existence stepping out as his hair shone with a verdant gold radiance, a dazzling verdant gold robe draping over him as it put all EPOCH Relics to shame.

This being remained in the periphery of the billowing dog as he did not step out of it- his hands only waving forward to release a verdant point of light that began to enlarge into a massive green platform that revealed the auras of existences that even the weakest of...seemed to be that of Reverends who had at least 9 Boundaries at the 9th Boundary Layer!
As for the most powerful...their bodies carried a sense of grace and grandeur of Consummate Boundaries as the very potent pressure of Extremity swirled around them peacefully.
Their number reached twice a dozen as the Apex Aeonic Lifeform who had transferred them across the cracks of Havens looked towards them calmly as his resonant voice rang out.

<The Extremity Vein in the Youngest Haven has begun its Initiation as the process of Sanctification is underway in this Haven. If you can reach the depths of the Initiating Extremity Vein of Dissolution and obtain the Extremity Panaceas, you will achieve an Extremity Foundation akin to the legends you admire and hear of now before you become Apex Aeonic Life Forms. Such a foundation is critical in reaching Extremity in the future...so use any means necessary to obtain it.>
WAA!

An austere air of power and wonder surged out at his words as among the twice a dozen auras on the verdant platform he had released, a devilishly handsome man with regality and nobility dripping from every part of his body spoke out.
<Our actions towards the Aboriginals in the Haven?>
His words were cold and callous as if he didn't consider those in this Haven anywhere near as pristine as himself and the others here!
The Apex Aeonic Lifeform still in the billowing fog of Extremity waved his hands dismissively as he replied while the fog began to envelop him.
<Go easy on them. They also have the right to fight for the opportunities of their Haven, but they will not be able to hinder you all in obtaining what you want.>
WAA!
Dazzling waves of Extremity surged in the surroundings as unique existences arrived in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution after crossing the crevices between different Havens.

They were unique and powerful...but they weren't the only ones as from other Havens, those similar to them were arriving around the same time as the initiation of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution was something significant!

chapters.title: Chapter 2326 Across The Lands! V
paragraphs: Existences from other Havens on the cusp of becoming Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were moved across the walls of Havens to appear into the past Haven that began its Extremity Sanctification!
But even among these existences, there were some of truly special standing and dispositions who also arrived.
In a region filled with raging storms of NULLITY and RUIN, the billowing fog connecting endless the skies and earth rolled and opened calmly as two figures stepped out of it.

One was an aged old man with radiant red and gold hair neatly trimmed, a pair of small Crimson horns rising from the top of his head as his face was full of vigor and life as a clean goatee shone with radiance!

His eyes sparkled with immense knowledge and mystery as he gazed at the roiling lightning and thundering of NULLITY and RUIN as he smiled, speaking towards the young woman beside him that he pushed forward.
"Just obtain the Extremity Panacea to set up your Foundation, Ayame. Leave the rest of the opportunities for the Aboriginals of this Haven, it was meant for them to forge their path anyways."
Not an ounce of authority could be felt from his words.
From all accounts, he actually seemed like an Entity full of mysteries- no ounce of danger or aura raging around him as it was extremely unique to see!
The young woman he talked to was slim and slender, with similar fiery red gold hair snaking past her shoulders as she held a single stellar Crimson horn sprouting out of her forehead.

Her aura was strong and filled with regality as over a dozen Boundaries at the very peak of the 9th Boundary Layer silently coiled around her, a smile of power and humility radiating from her face as she waved towards the old man behind her.

<Don't worry, Grandpa Daichi. Even though other Treasures exist to build an Extremity Foundation in our Vaults, nothing beats the Extremity Panacea from a waking Extremity Vein. The Panaceas coming from this Haven of Dissolution will be the last in all the Seven Havens as the last generation of Existences to reach Extremity will be born from them. Providence tells me my path will start here.>

Her words caused the surrounding essence to surge cheerfully as they carried shocking power, the one she referred to as Grandpa Daichi nodding lovingly at her words as the stellar fog calmly began to wrap around him.
Before he left, his hand flickered lightly as he released an aura for the first time- this light coming to land on Ayame to her own surprise as she shook her head wryly soon after.
But this flash of light caused the nearby NULLITY and RUIN to tremble and calm down, their tendrils even bowing towards it in shock as it was a light that exceeded all Boundaries!
It was...a light of a concept that had truly reached Extremity.
WAA!
Extremity!
Such a light landed on Ayame as who in this Haven could even dream to do anything against her?
Her crimson horn flickered and absorbed the light of an unknown concept of Extremity as she bowed towards the fog before turning around and taking a step forward.

Every time she did so, space twisted as she appeared light years away, her face full of exceeding calm and beauty as in terms of speed, she outmatched any guests that were entering the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution currently!
OOOH
His bellows caused the stellar darkness above to flicker while the Obsidian earth below churned!

He threw the figure of the Varicella Emperor Kong onto the Arachnoid Prion Queen as he surged forward like an unhinged bullet, a cerulean aurora of wings erupting behind him while raging blue flames from Infinity symbols flickering like singularities crashed out.
He seemed wilder than even the Beasts here as the Reverends watching became grimmer and grimmer!
This was because they could feel his rising aura.
It didn't stop at releasing a grand Consummate Light three times as from there on...it continued.
For a fourth time.
For a fifth time!
His aura seemed to rouse the potent aura of Extremity in the surroundings as it surged towards him and was absorbed into his Soul, with his touring aura beginning to spread across the lands!
It pressed onto the stellar black earth and the abyssal skies above.

It reached out to press on the souls of all beings here as of course the Reverends would pour attention into him and the wildness he displayed while his aura of Consummate Boundaries stretched out all around!
And none were more focused than Ancestral Lerneans as their Reverends focused on his figure and then turned towards Ophelia, their eyes full of understanding and expectation.
They had to clear the situation and affirm this being's standing in their Lineage!

But it didn't seem like they could approach his raging figure at this moment as while the Varicella Emperor Kong roared out towards him and the Arachnoid Prion Queen spat out countless webs, his figure continued to move wildly as a sea of blue flames, singularities, Infinity symbols, and much more thundered down to blanket everything in a wild show of wonder.
And how could he not be wild?!

His Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul was roaring out with maddening grandeur as its strongest concepts were altered to an even greater level, and the sheer changes brought about through them had to be experienced for him to fully understand!
He could see that from Quintessence, Blood, and Loot- their Boundary Layers were ever so subtly changed as the Layers that had the All Aeonic Parameter Values were scaled upwards greatly.
·ƈθm And it was crucial to understand that currently - two changes were taking place simultaneously.

One was Noah bringing 9 concepts to the 6th Boundary Layer and then Designating them as Quintessential to instantly have them arrive at the 9th Boundary Layer, and the second change was him using his authority as an Aeonic Quintessential Curator to alter these concepts to the Consummate level.
So, many new Layers were added from these 9 Boundaries as some of them granted additional augmentations to All Aeonic Parameter Values among other boons!
It was an overload of information.
Information that if written out, they could fill entire pages with 81 excerpts of just each of the Boundary Layers for the 9 Boundaries!

chapters.title: Chapter 2327 Across The Lands! VI
paragraphs: So...Noah wanted to simplify these changes as he focused on the most important ones.
While his True Sanguine Clone moved wildly in the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, his Main Body went through the abundant information and gave out commands.
<Bring up the most pertinent Layers in relation to my current strength from each of the 9 Boundaries.>
<Put together all the All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentations from each Boundary and display it under a stat panel.>
WAA!

A dazzling blue stat panel unfurled in his mind as the long version was countless pages with everything he had. The short and condensed version currently showed his Name, Titles, Natural Laws, Decreta, Killing Techniques, Foundation, Boundaries, and what his current maximum Damage Output, Defense, and Vitality Values were.

He gazed at the section of Natural Laws and Decreta as he waved his hands to have this disappear as well- and this was because all of these concepts were expanded towards Extremity as they're also listed under Boundaries!

His Stat Panel became even more condensed as he nodded while gazing at the Boundaries section that listed the 9 Boundaries that had over half already at the Consummate level while his Soul continued to spend more of itself as an Aeonic Quintessential Curator to turn the rest towards the same level.
With every passing second, another would join the ranks of the Consummate Tier.
HOONG!
And his soul would cry out with fervor.
And the lands around him would tremble as his bodies in the Vaults of Extremity sucked in the surrounding aura of Extremity to fuel his rise!
His eyes released a terrific light of power as he focused on the Boundaries that had already reached the 9th Boundary Layer and the Consummate level.
He felt that as he went down the list, all of them would arrive at this place in the seconds to follow as everything would be neatly quantified!
His eyes first went to the Boundary responsible for all these changes, focusing on the overall All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation shown beside this Boundary.
<Boundary of Quintessence>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 25,000%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...

An astonishing change in just the All Aeonic Parameter Values Augmentation came from Quintessence after it entered the Golden Consummate Tier- and this wasn't to mention any alterations on the other Layers of this Boundary!
This was one of the causes for his explosion of power as after this, his eyes continued down the list.
<Boundary of Loot>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,999%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Blood>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,500%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Dimensions>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,500%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Entropy>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 35,999%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
Noah's gaze came to a pause when he reached Entropy.
At this moment in time, countless changes were blooming with his Aspects of Existence as it was hard to say what they were due to when he had so many things happening all at once.
But at this moment, he saw the mere boons of Entropy alone that almost neared what 3 Golden Consummate Boundaries of his granted!
The augmentation of Entropy alone even exceeded his strongest Boundary that was undoubtedly Quintessence as this...
<<This is partly due to the 9th Boundary Layer of Entropy, and the overall nature of Reality in the Havens of Extremity.>>
WAA!
The words of the Source of Reality rang in Noah's mind as it knew more than anyone else about the expanded Natural Laws.

Their transformations were occurring in real time as with all the changes that Noah was going through, the Infinite Plane that was bound by the Fundamental Natural Laws undergoing the expansion to Extremity was undergoing even greater changes than Noah!
The Infinite Plane knew this closely as during the expansion of Fundamental Natural Laws, it focused on what Entropy would bring!
And everything was now unveiled as the Will of the Infinite Plane drew Noah to gaze under the section of [Featured Boundaries] of Entropy, the first of which was the 9th Boundary Layer.

<The Ninth Boundary Layer of Entropy>:: Disorder is the immutable flow of reality, order is but a mere illusion of weaker existences. The flow of nature is always increasing in Entropy, with things in an ever constant state of expansion and transformation. As a being who has bound the workings of Entropy and aided in its transformation towards Extremity, you have gained the distinction of the Entropic Entity of Extremity- an existence that thrives and grows more powerful amidst increased chaos and disorder. To other existences, Entropy unsettles and overwhelms them- but to an Entropic Entity of Extremity, Entropy is something you can control. At this moment, your soul will begin a transformation to an Entropic Entity of Extremity as part of the unfolding abilities is that every action you now take will mobilize the Sources of chaos and disorder in your surroundings to temporarily move with your will. Previous augmentation of past Layers will also rise and change as other abilities will unfold once the transformation is completed...
Noah's soul buzzed.

Among the many changes occurring with his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul, it seemed a particularly dreadful one was taking place as...exactly what did one of the crucial sentences in the detail of the 9th Boundary Layer of Entropy mean?
<...every action you now take will mobilize the Sources of chaos and disorder in your surroundings to temporarily move with your will...>
The Sources of chaos and disorder around him.
Before Noah could theorize just what this entailed...his True Sanguine Clone in the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands felt it closely as incredulous changes bloomed!

At this moment, Noah's True Sanguine Clone had a sea of blue flames behind him and singularities flying towards the Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen when a phenomenon that even caused Ophelia's jaws to drop bloomed.
When the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans erupted out, each of them surged with torrential tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN at an extremely high level.
And towards the deeper depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, one could see even greater concentrations of surging RUIN and NULLITY.
Yet at this moment, around Noah's figure bathed in cerulean flames...it felt like time slowed down as from the surroundings.
From the bodies of the Varicella Emperor Kong and the Arachnoid Prion Queen.
From the bodies of other Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans nearby...
The tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY flowed out like tamed souls as they turned into wisps that joined his blue flames.
He didn't know of them.
He did not have them expanded towards Extremity!

Yet...he commandeered them from the surroundings as his glorious visage became surrounded by blue flames that in their exterior...shimmering crimson and silver light began to join in astonishing brilliance as the Leviathans he targeted felt a sense of danger for the first time since the veil was torn down!!!

sentences.text: So...Noah wanted to simplify these changes as he focused on the most important ones.
While his True Sanguine Clone moved wildly in the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, his Main Body went through the abundant information and gave out commands.
<Bring up the most pertinent Layers in relation to my current strength from each of the 9 Boundaries.>
<Put together all the All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentations from each Boundary and display it under a stat panel.>
WAA!
A dazzling blue stat panel unfurled in his mind as the long version was countless pages with everything he had.

The short and condensed version currently showed his Name, Titles, Natural Laws, Decreta, Killing Techniques, Foundation, Boundaries, and what his current maximum Damage Output, Defense, and Vitality Values were.

He gazed at the section of Natural Laws and Decreta as he waved his hands to have this disappear as well- and this was because all of these concepts were expanded towards Extremity as they're also listed under Boundaries!

His Stat Panel became even more condensed as he nodded while gazing at the Boundaries section that listed the 9 Boundaries that had over half already at the Consummate level while his Soul continued to spend more of itself as an Aeonic Quintessential Curator to turn the rest towards the same level.
With every passing second, another would join the ranks of the Consummate Tier.
HOONG!
And his soul would cry out with fervor.
And the lands around him would tremble as his bodies in the Vaults of Extremity sucked in the surrounding aura of Extremity to fuel his rise!
His eyes released a terrific light of power as he focused on the Boundaries that had already reached the 9th Boundary Layer and the Consummate level.
He felt that as he went down the list, all of them would arrive at this place in the seconds to follow as everything would be neatly quantified!
His eyes first went to the Boundary responsible for all these changes, focusing on the overall All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation shown beside this Boundary.
<Boundary of Quintessence>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 25,000%.
[Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...

An astonishing change in just the All Aeonic Parameter Values Augmentation came from Quintessence after it entered the Golden Consummate Tier- and this wasn't to mention any alterations on the other Layers of this Boundary!
This was one of the causes for his explosion of power as after this, his eyes continued down the list.
<Boundary of Loot>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,999%.
[Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Blood>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,500%.
[Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Dimensions>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,500%.
[Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Entropy>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 35,999%.
[Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
Noah's gaze came to a pause when he reached Entropy.
At this moment in time, countless changes were blooming with his Aspects of Existence as it was hard to say what they were due to when he had so many things happening all at once.
But at this moment, he saw the mere boons of Entropy alone that almost neared what 3 Golden Consummate Boundaries of his granted!
The augmentation of Entropy alone even exceeded his strongest Boundary that was undoubtedly Quintessence as this...
<<This is partly due to the 9th Boundary Layer of Entropy, and the overall nature of Reality in the Havens of Extremity.>>
WAA!
The words of the Source of Reality rang in Noah's mind as it knew more than anyone else about the expanded Natural Laws.

Their transformations were occurring in real time as with all the changes that Noah was going through, the Infinite Plane that was bound by the Fundamental Natural Laws undergoing the expansion to Extremity was undergoing even greater changes than Noah!
The Infinite Plane knew this closely as during the expansion of Fundamental Natural Laws, it focused on what Entropy would bring!
And everything was now unveiled as the Will of the Infinite Plane drew Noah to gaze under the section of [Featured Boundaries] of Entropy, the first of which was the 9th Boundary Layer.
<The Ninth Boundary Layer of Entropy>:: Disorder is the immutable flow of reality, order is but a mere illusion of weaker existences.
The flow of nature is always increasing in Entropy, with things in an ever constant state of expansion and transformation.

As a being who has bound the workings of Entropy and aided in its transformation towards Extremity, you have gained the distinction of the Entropic Entity of Extremity- an existence that thrives and grows more powerful amidst increased chaos and disorder.
To other existences, Entropy unsettles and overwhelms them- but to an Entropic Entity of Extremity, Entropy is something you can control.

At this moment, your soul will begin a transformation to an Entropic Entity of Extremity as part of the unfolding abilities is that every action you now take will mobilize the Sources of chaos and disorder in your surroundings to temporarily move with your will.
Previous augmentation of past Layers will also rise and change as other abilities will unfold once the transformation is completed...
Noah's soul buzzed.

Among the many changes occurring with his Aeonic Quintessential Mana Soul, it seemed a particularly dreadful one was taking place as...exactly what did one of the crucial sentences in the detail of the 9th Boundary Layer of Entropy mean?
<...every action you now take will mobilize the Sources of chaos and disorder in your surroundings to temporarily move with your will...>
The Sources of chaos and disorder around him.
Before Noah could theorize just what this entailed...his True Sanguine Clone in the periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands felt it closely as incredulous changes bloomed!

At this moment, Noah's True Sanguine Clone had a sea of blue flames behind him and singularities flying towards the Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen when a phenomenon that even caused Ophelia's jaws to drop bloomed.
When the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans erupted out, each of them surged with torrential tendrils of NULLITY and RUIN at an extremely high level.
And towards the deeper depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, one could see even greater concentrations of surging RUIN and NULLITY.
Yet at this moment, around Noah's figure bathed in cerulean flames...it felt like time slowed down as from the surroundings.
From the bodies of the Varicella Emperor Kong and the Arachnoid Prion Queen.
From the bodies of other Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans nearby...
The tendrils of RUIN and NULLITY flowed out like tamed souls as they turned into wisps that joined his blue flames.
He didn't know of them.
He did not have them expanded towards Extremity!

Yet...he commandeered them from the surroundings as his glorious visage became surrounded by blue flames that in their exterior...shimmering crimson and silver light began to join in astonishing brilliance as the Leviathans he targeted felt a sense of danger for the first time since the veil was torn down!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 2328 Chaos I
paragraphs: Shimmering crimson and silver tendrils of light began to join his blue flames as ushered by Entropy, the Sources of Chaos in the surroundings followed Noah's will!

The Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen he targeted felt a sense of danger for the first time since the veil was torn down as their bodies fantastically flickered to turn into countless foamy particles similar to what many other Leviathans had shown the capability to do so in recent battles.
And the flames bounded by entropy and disorder crashed down.
BOOOOM!

The impact was immensely heavy as a shocking indentation appeared on the stellar black earth as if an inverted mountain was carved out, the vibrations and waves of power spreading out to give rise to the stellar black earth to fissure and crack across this region!

The residual impact of the blow even blasted out into a pressure wave that passed through the bodies of the Ancestral Lernaeans, Quasarians, and Noblesse as the weaker beings at the 6th Boundary Layer were forced to spit blood and sustain injuries from the mere Shockwaves alone.

The Leviathans that had turned into foam restructured their bodies from the vast crater as when they returned to their glorious figures of the Varicella Emperor Kong and Arachnoid Prion Queen...one could see the crimson black fur of the Kong stained with blood as one of his arms was lost, while the Arachnoid Prion Queen had a huge gash spreading over her carapace!
ROAAR!
They released maddening roars as for the first time, the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans actually suffered a loss.
And the being to do so...

He currently floated above the massive stellar craters he created as its earth melted and began to crystallize, his figure shrouded by blue flames that became tinged with Crimson and Silver grandeur at this moment.
And as NULLITY and RUIN mixed in due to his distinction of the Entropic Entity of Extremity stemming from the Boundary of Entropy...
<Your understanding of NULLITY is Quintessentially increasing.>
<You have begun to understand RUIN.>
WAA!
Noah's eyes flashed brilliantly as he caught onto one of the concepts that more intricately followed the course of nature more than anything else.
Because inherently...nature was predisposed and always going towards more chaos and disorder!
If he could reign in a concept presiding over this and take it to Extremity...
Many possibilities bloomed in his mind as even greater changes occurred around him.

The auras of more and more Consummate Boundary Layer erupted from him that continued to make others tremble, some even becoming distrustful as within the Lernean Reverends- one known as Reverend Imamu spoke towards Elder Ancestor Rodwig and other Elder Ancestors who normally took hold of the day to day ongoing of the various Sacrariums.
<No such being is in our ranks, right? But that Ophelia...>

Their eyes hungrily looked towards Ophelia as from her dazzling figure, they could see the outburst of a Consummate Boundary similar to the first multicolored light that shone over the anomalous Entity before them!
Since she moved with him, it showed their connection and the fact that this was a genuine Consummate Boundary that they could learn.
Ancestor Rodwig's pupils shone with a glorious sword light as he spoke out slowly.
<We have to get a hold of her and communicate well. I've already sent the message to gather some of our Elder Ancestors towards the Abecedarian Sacrarium where her main body should be.>

Ancestor Rodwig moved quickly as Reverend Imamu nodded, his body brimming with power as he observed the unfolding chaos which drawing deeper into the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands, leaving behind one last message.

<Good. He seems to have a conflict with us as he didn't differentiate between friend or foe when he first arrived. Clear this up first and give up whoever offended him. Build a strong relationship through Ophelia and let's get our hands on this Consummate Boundary...or multiple of them if the auras around him are to be believed!>
Destiny rose and fell in wondrous waves as many beings continued their own movements and followed intricate paths amidst the unfolding chaos.

Back in the Source of Reality, Noah's main body licked his lips as he felt the sensation coursing through his True Sanguine Clone due to the distinction of Entropic Entity of Extremity- his Soul feeling as if the more chaos there was out there, the more powerful he would become!

Of course, this could also be another sensation he felt as multiple other Boundaries he chose were designated as Quintessential- their Boundary Layers exploding to reach the 9th Boundary Layer as Noah used his authority as the Quintessential Aeonic Curator to elevate them towards the Golden Consummate Tier thereafter.
He continued to read over their augmentations first before he jumped to see the featured Boundary Layers of Entropy and the other newly expanded concepts.
<Boundary of Manadynamics>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 20,000%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Providence>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,500%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
<Boundary of Conquest>::...Current All Aeonic Parameter Value Augmentation: 12,500%. [Featured Boundary Layers], [All Boundary Layers]...
WAA!
Yes!
Conquest was also something that greatly defined Noah as he chose to expand this towards Extremity!
Quintessence, Loot, Blood, Dimensions, Entropy, Manadynamics, Providence, and Conquest.

Noah's soul stopped here briefly as he had other plans for a Ninth and Tenth Boundary to raise to the 9th Boundary Layer and make them at the Consummate Tier, but he had to put a hold as not too long ago, the prompts that spoke of NULLITY and RUIN appeared.

He had to study these a bit more as the expanded concept of Providence had begun to feed him information that he doubted Ophelia would ever receive from the concept of Wisdom, with one thing already being made clear.

The time he began to massacre the Aeonic Abyssal Sanctity Leviathans would be the time he would quickly ascend the Primitivus, Proficere, and Terminus stages of NULLITY and RUIN as he could then expand them into Extremity and attain a fantastical tool in his hands!

chapters.title: Chapter 2329 Chaos II
paragraphs: Outside of the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity.
A figure shot out of its inky black depths silently as more figures and vessels could actually be seen jumping into the Abyss at the same time.
It was none other than Oppenheimer who was wrapped with a light stemming from the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform that very few others could ever hope of seeing through!
He silently moved out of the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity as his destinations were many, with a great number of things he had to do before he fully began to move.

The Noblesse Commanders around him earlier in the outer periphery of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands had scoffed at the possibility that Ancestral Lernaeans thought he may have been more than just a defector- the reason for this was because they knew the price that Oppenheimer paid to gain their trust!

Even with the methods Desiderius had provided for him, Oppenheimer had to give up a significant portion of his Soul to be held in the Spirit Hall of Noblesse that was always under the guard of Reverends.
A location that was one of the major points of communication, and it was stretched out to multiple domains of the Noblesse.

Oppenheimer knew exactly which domain the portion of his Soul was hidden in as with the Eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, he should be able to enter and leave it unscathed and unseen as he retrieved his Soul and closed off any avenues of danger in the future- before any of the Noblesse Commanders amidst the chaos realized he was no longer there!
With his body glimmering with radiance, he left the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity and turned towards the direction that held the Domains of the Noblesse Lineage.
Lightyears away from the Abecedarian Sacrarium.

A stretch of stellar gold vegetation could be seen endlessly painting the earth below as the skies carried a hazy glow of gold, with the constantly changing auras of multiple figures seen crossing this region atop another Chaoticus Behemoth Transporter from the Abecedarian Sacrarium!

At the forefront of it was the figure of Henry, accompanied by the Blue Slime bouncing on his head, Kazuhiko tightly grasping a sword not too far away, and the figures of the Kraken, Emperor Penguin, Dimensional Rulers like Eowyn and Guinevere, and many others that joined him on his mission.
Henry's eyes were sharp as he gazed out at the vastness around him.
He knew his father well.
What others achieved in centuries, he achieved within seconds.
It took billions of years for others to reach the 9th Boundary Layer of a concept...his father had already reached this within a matter of days- his Lineage told him so!
So the moment that his Father told him to move and deliver the Noblesse domains to him, Henry knew he had to act fast.
Otherwise, while he began conquering one Noblesse Domain, his father may have already finished dominating the Ancestral Lernaeans and all their Sacrariums.
So he moved out as quickly as he could, Complete Aeonic Pearls of Extremity still swirling around him as his destiny showed him many paths.

And even more paths opened up in the last minute as he felt Quintessence- the Boundary he chose to focus on and use a Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity to bring to the 6th Boundary Layer...he felt its profound elevation to the Consummate Boundary Tier as the 6 Boundary Layers he just learned were altered stupendously!

Quintessence was automatically deemed Quintessential as it was in its name- and it could now exceed 2 Quintessential Apocryphal Layers on itself and any other Boundaries that Henry had...with the maximum limitation being not exceeding the 9th Boundary Layer.
So his total Boundary Layers of Quintessence instantly became 8 as his Aeonic Soul released eye-catching brilliance.

The next Boundary he had utilized a Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearl of Extremity on was Providence as at this moment, he also applied the effect of Quintessence on it as it added two Apocryphal Layers!
That made it two Boundaries at the 8th Boundary Layer!

And as he optimized his power over the next few minutes...he would add Destiny, Loot, Blood, Manadynamics, and Entropy into this as he would be an existence who rose rapidly in power similar to his father...achieving what others took billions of years to do in a span of a day.

Even at this very second, his extremely young soul was transforming into something at the level of power that began to exceed average Elder Ancestors of the Ancestral Lernaeans like Elder Ancestor Rodwig!
And it would only grow stronger as he included more and more Boundaries to the 8th Boundary Layer...such an unimaginable thing actually being made possible at this moment.
And...it was all due to his father.

The Loot that made it possible, and whatever ridiculous method he used to turn Quintessence into a Consummate Boundary as even at this moment, Henry felt other Boundaries originating from his father rousing and going towards the same level.
"Hooo..."
He breathed out to contain himself and his bubbling power as he gazed out into the expanse before him.
Yes, everything he had achieved now was due to his father.

He wanted to see if he could obtain something by himself as this mission to deliver the Noblesse Domains to him...he would see if he could get a hold of stupendous Loot and grandeur with his own hands as well!
And his newly enacted Boundary of Providence that reached the 8th Boundary Layer with the help of Quintessence shone.
He was looking at the many paths he could take in the Lands of the Noblesse when at the same time, his golden heart released a profound brilliance as his gaze changed!
"Oh?"
Tendrils of golden destiny released from his eyes as he foresaw countless things.
Destiny and Providence told him many things as he saw that his incursion into the Noblesse...he would have a chance of a profound opportunity that didn't actually have to do with this Lineage!
This caused Henry to be confused as what could he get from the Domains of the Noblesse that wasn't connected to the Noblesse Lineage itself?
<Give me a clue. A place, a name...anything!>
He spoke out authoritatively in his mind as his Aeonic Soul Values were drained out rapidly.
The Child of Destiny released a profound golden radiance as in his mind, a single word unfolded after nearly all of his Aeonic Soul Values were spent!
[Oppenheimer]
Oppenheimer.
Henry's eyes expanded as very soon, a devilish smile inherited from his father bloomed as his eyes released blinding radiance!
